## Prerequisites

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, echo = FALSE, error = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE) 
# eval defines code running
# echo defines code display (if false, there will be no code display but the output will be there, and the code will still run)
# include defines code&output display (if false, there will be no code display, no output, but the code will still run)
# error defines whether to continue running code (and display errors) when they occur
# message defines whether to display code messages
# warning defines whether to display code warnings
```

We load necessary libraries and set the working directory.

```{r}
library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(data.table)

dir <- "~/Dropbox/dropbox_work/data/assorted_fasterX/"
```

## Grantham's distance

We format Grantham's distance values for later use, and we provide a list of possible nonsynonmous/synonymous mutations.

```{r}
#Import Grantham's distance data
grantham <- read.table(paste0(dir,"granthams_distance/grantham.tsv"),h=T)
#Clean the table, so that it' includes's symmetric and includes synonymous changes too (Distance = 0)
rownames(grantham) <- grantham$FIRST
names(grantham)[1] <- "S" 
grantham$S <- 0
grantham[20,] <- 0
Grantham <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(forceSymmetric(as.matrix(grantham))))
```

## Amino acid pairs

```{r}
###############################
## Nonsynonymous sites ####
###############################

dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"))

syn_amino <- paste(colnames(Grantham),colnames(Grantham),sep="_")
all_amino <- levels(factor(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent))[-grep("\\*",levels(factor(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent)))]
nonsyn_amino <- all_amino[!(substr(str_extract(all_amino,"..."),3,3)==substr(str_extract(all_amino,"..."),1,1))]

four_amino <- syn_amino[ syn_amino%in% levels(factor(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent[dmel.X.m$Degeneracy==4]))]
zero_amino <- levels(factor(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent[dmel.X.m$Degeneracy==0]))[-grep("\\*",levels(factor(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent[dmel.X.m$Degeneracy==0])))]
zero_amino <- zero_amino[!(substr(str_extract(zero_amino,"..."),3,3)==substr(str_extract(zero_amino,"..."),1,1))]

rm(dmel.X.m)
```

## Theory

### FGM visualisation

```{r}
# z = 0.5

n = 2 #no. traits
z = 0.5 #distance from optimum
m = 0.15 #st. dev. mutation effects per trait
cos.theta = 0.8 #orientation away from optimum
theta = acos(cos.theta) #angle away from optimum

O = rep(0, n) #location of optimum
A = c(-z*cos(theta), -z*sin(theta), rep(0, n-2))  #wild type phenotype

#simulated mutations
no.mutations = 10^5

#vectors to hold dominance coefficients and phenotypic effects
h.ben = vector()
h.del = vector()
s.het = vector()
s.hom = vector()
P.mut.1 = vector()
P.mut.2 = vector()

ben.mutation = 0
del.mutation = 0

#loop to simulate mutations
for(i in 1:no.mutations){
  r = m*sqrt(rchisq(1, n, ncp = 0)) #mutation magnitude
  x = rnorm(n) #vector of standard normal random variables
  M = r*x/sqrt(sum(x^2)) #homozygous effects on the set of traits
  
  P.mut.1[i] = A[1] + M[1]/2
  P.mut.2[i] = A[2] + M[2]/2
  
  #heterozygote and homozygote distances from optimum
  z.het = sqrt(sum((A + M/2 - O)^2))
  z.hom = sqrt(sum((A + M - O)^2))
  
  #fitness effects, per sex
  s.het[i] = exp(-0.5*z.het^2)/exp(-0.5*z^2) - 1
  s.hom[i] = exp(-0.5*z.hom^2)/exp(-0.5*z^2) - 1
}

#just the net beneficial alleles with SA effects
#Condition for positive selection among overdominant mutations (expression in both sexes)
OD.sel.a = s.het > 0 & s.het > s.hom & s.hom > (3 - s.het)/4*(sqrt(1 + 16*s.het/(3 - s.het)^2) - 1)
#Condition for balancing selection among overdominant mutations (expression in both sexes)
OD.sel.b = s.het > 0 & s.het > s.hom & s.hom < (3 - s.het)/4*(sqrt(1 + 16*s.het/(3 - s.het)^2) - 1)
#Condition for positive selection among overdominant mutations (male-limited)
OD.sel.c = s.het > 0 & s.het > s.hom & s.hom > 0 
#Condition for unconditionally beneficial mutations (all under positive selection)
Pos.sel = s.het > 0 & s.hom >= s.het

#Multiple logical vector with mutation vector (trait 1), such that if it's false, then the point will appear at x=0,y=0
OD.1a = OD.sel.a*P.mut.1
OD.2a = OD.sel.a*P.mut.2
OD.1b = OD.sel.b*P.mut.1
OD.2b = OD.sel.b*P.mut.2
OD.1c = OD.sel.c*P.mut.1
OD.2c = OD.sel.c*P.mut.2
ben.1 = Pos.sel*P.mut.1
ben.2 = Pos.sel*P.mut.2

# Expression in both sexes

png("~/Dropbox/dropbox_work/projects/assorted_fasterX/assorted_fasterX_repo/plots/theory/FGM_large_effect.png", width = 800, height = 800,res = 200)
#plot the optimum (open point) and phenotype of wild-type homozygote (filled point)
plot(1:10,asp = 1, type = "n", ylim = c(-1.2*z, 1.2*z), xlim = c(-1.2*z, 1.2*z), xlab = "trait 1", ylab = "trait 2")
#draw.circle(0, 0, z, col = "white")

#plot phenotypes
points(P.mut.1, P.mut.2, pch = 16, col = "lightgrey", cex = 0.25)
points(ben.1, ben.2, pch = 16, col = "sky blue", cex = 0.25)
points(OD.1b, OD.2b, pch = 16, col = "red", cex = 0.25)
#points(OD.1c, OD.2c, pch = 16, col = "orange", cex = 0.25)
points(OD.1a, OD.2a, pch = 16, col = "orange", cex = 0.25)

draw.circle(0, 0, z, col = NA)
points(A[1],A[2], pch = 16, cex = 1.2)
lines(c(0,A[1]), c(0,A[2]), lty = 3)
points(0,0, pch = 21, bg = "white", lwd = 2, cex = 1.2)
dev.off()



# Male-limited

png("~/Dropbox/dropbox_work/projects/assorted_fasterX/assorted_fasterX_repo/plots/theory/FGM_large_effect_ml.png", width = 800, height = 800,res = 200)
#plot the optimum (open point) and phenotype of wild-type homozygote (filled point)
plot(1:10,asp = 1, type = "n", ylim = c(-1.2*z, 1.2*z), xlim = c(-1.2*z, 1.2*z), xlab = "trait 1", ylab = "trait 2")
#draw.circle(0, 0, z, col = "white")

#plot phenotypes
points(P.mut.1, P.mut.2, pch = 16, col = "lightgrey", cex = 0.25)
points(ben.1, ben.2, pch = 16, col = "sky blue", cex = 0.25)
points(OD.1b, OD.2b, pch = 16, col = "red", cex = 0.25)
points(OD.1c, OD.2c, pch = 16, col = "orange", cex = 0.25)
#points(OD.1a, OD.2a, pch = 16, col = "orange", cex = 0.25)

draw.circle(0, 0, z, col = NA)
points(A[1],A[2], pch = 16, cex = 1.2)
lines(c(0,A[1]), c(0,A[2]), lty = 3)
```

### Scaled effect size vs RX/RA

```{r}
# Define parameters
z <- 1  # z and n cancel out in ratio, so one can set them to 1
n <- 1
erf <- function(x) 2 * pnorm(x * sqrt(2)) - 1

# Equal expression in both sexes
# Eq. S20
Pr_fix_A_x <- function(x,v) {
  term1 <- (sqrt(2) / sqrt(pi)) * exp(- (x * (1 + v) / sqrt(2))^2)
  term2 <- x * v * (1 - erf(x * (1 + v) / sqrt(2)))
  (2 * z^2 / n) * x * v * (term1 - term2)
}
# Eq. S21
Pr_fix_X_x <- function(x,v) {
  numerator_exp <- x * (3 - 2 * v^2)
  denominator_exp <- (3 - 2 * v) * sqrt(2)
  term1 <- ((1 + 2 * v) * sqrt(2) / sqrt(pi)) * exp(- (numerator_exp / denominator_exp)^2)
  term2 <- x * (1 + 2 * v^2) * (1 - erf(numerator_exp / denominator_exp))
  (2 * z^2 / (3 * n)) * x * (term1 - term2)
}

# Male-limited
# Eq. S25
Pr_fix_A_x_ml <- function(x,v) {
  term1 <- (z^2 / n) * x * v
  inner <- (sqrt(2) / sqrt(pi)) * exp(- (x * (1 + v) / sqrt(2))^2) -
    x * v * (1 - erf(x * (1 + v) / sqrt(2)))
  return(term1 * inner)
}
# Eq. S27 
Pr_fix_X_x_ml <- function(x,v) {
  term1 <- (2 * z^2) / (3 * n) * x
  inner <- (sqrt(2) / sqrt(pi)) * exp(-(x / sqrt(2))^2) -
    x * (1 - erf(x / sqrt(2)))
  return(term1 * inner)
}

x_vals <- seq(0.01, 3, length.out = 500)  # Avoid x=0 to prevent division by zero
v_vals <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)

get_ratios_both <- function(v) {
  A_vals <- 2 * Pr_fix_A_x(x_vals, v)
  X_vals <- 1.5 * Pr_fix_X_x(x_vals, v)
  ratio <- X_vals / A_vals
  data.frame(x = x_vals, ratio = ratio, v = as.factor(v), condition = "Both sexes")
}

get_ratios_ml <- function(v) {
  A_vals_ml <- 2 * Pr_fix_A_x_ml(x_vals, v)
  X_vals_ml <- 1.5 * Pr_fix_X_x_ml(x_vals, v)
  ratio_ml <- X_vals_ml / A_vals_ml
  data.frame(x = x_vals, ratio = ratio_ml, v = as.factor(v), condition = "Male-limited")
}

dd_both <- do.call(rbind, lapply(v_vals, get_ratios_both))
dd_ml <- do.call(rbind, lapply(v_vals, get_ratios_ml))
dd <- rbind(dd_both, dd_ml)
dd$first_point <- ifelse(dd$x==0.01,dd$ratio,NA)
names(dd)[3] <- "Dominance" 

ggplot(subset(dd,condition=="Both sexes"), aes(x = x, y = ratio, color = Dominance)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = first_point), size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log2',limits = c(0.5, 4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0.1" = "lightgreen", "0.5" = "forestgreen", "0.9" = "black"))+
  labs(x = "Scaled effect size (x)",y = expression(R["X"]/R["A"]),color = "Phenotypic dominance")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "top",legend.title = element_text(size=15),legend.text = element_text(size=15),axis.text=element_text(size=15),axis.title=element_text(size=20))
  
ggsave(filename = "RxRa_vs_effect_size.png",path="~/Dropbox/dropbox_work/projects/assorted_fasterX/assorted_fasterX_repo/plots/theory", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600)

ggplot(subset(dd,condition=="Male-limited"), aes(x = x, y = ratio, color = Dominance)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = first_point), size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log2',limits = c(0.5, 4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0.1" = "lightgreen", "0.5" = "forestgreen", "0.9" = "black"))+
  labs(x = "Scaled effect size (x)",y = expression(R["X"]/R["A"]),color = "Phenotypic dominance")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "top",legend.title = element_text(size=15),legend.text = element_text(size=15),axis.text=element_text(size=15),axis.title=element_text(size=20))

ggsave(filename = "RxRa_vs_effect_size_male_limited.png",path="~/Dropbox/dropbox_work/projects/assorted_fasterX/assorted_fasterX_repo/plots/theory", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600)

```

## *Drosophila melanogaster*

### Annotations (degenotate, SIFT)

Using the fasta file of the *D. melanogaster* reference genome, along with its gff file, we can identify what amino-acid change (if any) each mutation would cause.

```{r, engine = 'bash'}
## Identify 0- and 4-fold degenerate sites based on D. melanogaster annotation
python ~/Downloads/degenotate-main/degenotate.py -a downloads/gff/GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic.gff -g downloads/GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic.fna -d " " -o degenotate_v2;

# Filter transcript table to only include longest transcript (which will form the basis for multiple sequence alignment)
awk 'NR==FNR { keep[$1]; next } FNR==1 || ($1 in keep)' ../downloads/dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.transcriptIDs transcript-counts.tsv > transcript-counts-longest.tsv
# A list of FlyBase IDs for the genes that are used in downstream analysis 
join -a 1 -e "NA" -t $'\t' <(awk '{print $1 "\t" $0}' transcript-counts-longest.tsv | sort -k1,1) <(gawk -F'\t' '
    $3 == "CDS" && $9 ~ /Parent=rna-NM_.*;/ && $9 ~ /Dbxref=/ {
      split($9, a, ";")
      for (i in a) {
        gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", a[i])
        if (a[i] ~ /^Parent=/) { split(a[i], b, "="); parent = b[2] }
        if (a[i] ~ /^Dbxref=/) {
          split(a[i], b, "=")
          n = split(b[2], ids, ",")
          for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (ids[j] ~ /FBgn[0-9]+/) {
              sub(/^FLYBASE:/, "", ids[j])
              gene = ids[j]
            }
            if (ids[j] ~ /FBpp[0-9]+/) {
              sub(/^FLYBASE:/, "", ids[j])
              prot = ids[j]
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (parent && gene && prot && !seen[parent]++) {
        print parent "\t" gene "\t" prot
      }
      parent = gene = prot = ""
    }' GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic.gff | sort -k1,1) | cut -f2- > transcript-counts-longest_with_flybase.tsv

#Repair the transcript ID column to remove any characters after the colon; 
#convert the transcript ID column to gene IDs using the 'transcript-counts.tsv' file that maps transcripts to IDs (provided by degenotate); 
#remove any duplicate lines
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} FNR==NR{a[$1]=$2; b[$1]=$10; c[$1]=$11; next} {split($4,d,":"); if(d[1] in a){$4=d[1]; print $0, a[d[1]], b[d[1]], c[d[1]]}}' transcript-counts-longest_with_flybase.tsv degeneracy-all-sites.bed | awk '!seen[$0]++' > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.bed;

# Check that "REF" allele is the same strand as the reference genome; if not, correct it to the reference allele
awk 'BEGIN {printf("##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\n");}' > header.vcf;
awk -F "\t" '{OFS="\t";print $1,$3,".",$6,"A,T,C,G",".",".","."}' degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.bed | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n | cat header.vcf - > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.vcf;
bgzip -c degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.vcf > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.vcf.gz;
tabix -p vcf degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.vcf.gz;
bcftools norm -c s -f GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic.fna degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.vcf.gz -o degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.vcf;
awk -F'\t' 'FNR==NR && $0!~/^#/ {map[$1 FS $2]=$4; next} {k=$1 FS $3; if (k in map) print $0 OFS map[k]}' OFS='\t' degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.vcf degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.bed > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed;
rm degeneracy*duplicates_removed.vcf*; 
rm degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.bed;

#Subset to autosomes and X
grep -E "NT_033779\.4|NT_033778\.3|NT_037436\.3|NT_033777\.2" degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed > degeneracy-chrAUTO.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed;
grep "NC_004354.3" degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed > degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed;

# SIFT Annotations
https://sift.bii.a-star.edu.sg/sift4g/public/Drosophila_melanogaster/

# Keep only major chromosomes
bcftools annotate --rename-chrs chr_names.txt degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.vcf | bgzip -c - > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr.vcf.gz;
tabix -p vcf degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr.vcf.gz;
bcftools view -r 2L,2R,3L,3R,X -Ov degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr.vcf.gz > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr.vcf
rm degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr.vcf.gz*

# Get SIFT annotations for each position
java -jar ~/Downloads/SIFT4G_Annotator.jar -c -i degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr.vcf -d BDGP5.74 -r output -t

# Only keep a single transcript per site
awk '{
  key = $1 FS $2 FS $3 FS $4 FS $6 FS $7
  if (!seen[key]++) print
}' degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations.xls > degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls


# Split autosomes and X
grep -E "^2L|^2R|^3L|^3R" degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls > degeneracy-chrAUTO.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls 
grep -E "^X" degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls > degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls 

# Transform the table to facilitate import into R
awk -F'\t' '{
  key = $1 FS $2 FS $3 FS $6 FS $10
  alleles[key] = alleles[key] ? alleles[key] "," $4 : $4
  prot[key]   = prot[key] ? prot[key] "," $11 : $11
  preds[key]   = preds[key] ? preds[key] "," ""$13 : ""$13
  other[key] = $0
}
END {
  for (k in alleles) {
    split(k, a, FS)
    # Print columns 1–3, 6, 10, and concatenated columns 4, 11, 13
    print a[1], a[2], a[3], alleles[k], a[4], a[5], prot[k], preds[k]
  }
}' OFS='\t' degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript_wrapped.xls
  
awk -F'\t' '{
  key = $1 FS $2 FS $3 FS $6 FS $10
  alleles[key] = alleles[key] ? alleles[key] "," $4 : $4
  prot[key]   = prot[key] ? prot[key] "," $11 : $11
  preds[key]   = preds[key] ? preds[key] "," ""$13 : ""$13
  other[key] = $0
}
END {
  for (k in alleles) {
    split(k, a, FS)
    # Print columns 1–3, 6, 10, and concatenated columns 4, 11, 13
    print a[1], a[2], a[3], alleles[k], a[4], a[5], prot[k], preds[k]
  }
}' OFS='\t' degeneracy-chrAUTO.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > degeneracy-chrAUTO.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript_wrapped.xls

rm degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls; 
rm degeneracy-chrAUTO.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls;
rm degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript.xls
```

#### Clean annotations

Why are there some (very few) lines where a given chromosome position has duplicate transcript IDs?

##### X chromosome

```{r}
# 0-fold/4-fold status for any coding site
dmel.X.deg <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/processing/degenotate_v2/degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed"))
# Clean column names (REF refers to the reference allele assumed by degenotate; this can differ from the reference allele in the reference genome due to strandedness)
names(dmel.X.deg) <- c("Chrom","Pos_minus_1","Pos","Transcript","Degeneracy","REF","PROT","ALT_PROTS","Gene","Flybase","Flybase_prot","REF_fwd")
dmel.X.deg$Pos <- as.numeric(as.character(dmel.X.deg$Pos))
dmel.X.deg$Chrom <- "X"
dmel.X.deg$ID <- paste(dmel.X.deg$Chrom,dmel.X.deg$Pos,sep="_")
# Remove duplicated rows (note that, in cases where there are multiple transcripts per site, this will only keep one)
dmel.X.deg <- dmel.X.deg[!duplicated(dmel.X.deg[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID")]),]
# Clean Alt_prots columns, so that any given mutation corresponds to any given protein
dmel.X.deg$PROT_A <- with(dmel.X.deg,ifelse(REF=="A" | (REF!="A" & is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"A:."))),dmel.X.deg$PROT,ifelse(REF!="A" & !is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"A:.")),substr(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"A:."),3,3),NA)))
dmel.X.deg$PROT_T <- with(dmel.X.deg,ifelse(REF=="T" | (REF!="T" & is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"T:."))),dmel.X.deg$PROT,ifelse(REF!="T" & !is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"T:.")),substr(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"T:."),3,3),NA)))
dmel.X.deg$PROT_C <- with(dmel.X.deg,ifelse(REF=="C" | (REF!="C" & is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"C:."))),dmel.X.deg$PROT,ifelse(REF!="C" & !is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"C:.")),substr(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"C:."),3,3),NA)))
dmel.X.deg$PROT_G <- with(dmel.X.deg,ifelse(REF=="G" | (REF!="G" & is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"G:."))),dmel.X.deg$PROT,ifelse(REF!="G" & !is.na(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"G:.")),substr(str_extract(dmel.X.deg$ALT_PROTS,"G:."),3,3),NA)))
dmel.X.deg$REF_fwd <- toupper(dmel.X.deg$REF_fwd)
dmel.X.deg <- dmel.X.deg[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","REF","REF_fwd","Transcript","Gene","Flybase","Flybase_prot","Degeneracy","PROT_A","PROT_T","PROT_C","PROT_G")]

# Import SIFT scores
dmel.X.sift <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/processing/SIFT/output/degeneracy-chrX.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.maj_chr_SIFTannotations_singletranscript_wrapped.xls"))
names(dmel.X.sift) <- c("Chrom","Pos","REF_fwd","V4","Flybase","V6","V7","V8")
dmel.X.sift$ID <- paste(dmel.X.sift$Chrom,dmel.X.sift$Pos,sep="_")

# Combine SIFT and degenotate annotations
dmel.X.ann <- merge(dmel.X.deg,dmel.X.sift[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","V4","V6","V7","V8")],by=c("Chrom","Pos","ID"),all.x=T)
rm(dmel.X.deg)
rm(dmel.X.sift)

# First alternative allele in the VCF
dmel.X.ann$Allele2 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(dmel.X.ann$V4), split = ","), function(x) if (length(x) >= 1) x[1] else "")
# Convert allele to its complement if REF is on the reverse strand (SIFT scores are reported with respect to the strand that is transcribed)
dmel.X.ann$Allele2 <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(Allele2=="A" & REF_fwd!=REF,"T",ifelse(Allele2=="C" & REF_fwd!=REF,"G",ifelse(Allele2=="G" & REF_fwd!=REF,"C",ifelse(Allele2=="T" & REF_fwd!=REF,"A",Allele2)))))
# Second alternative allele
dmel.X.ann$Allele3 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(dmel.X.ann$V4), split = ","), function(x) if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else "")
# Convert allele to its complement if REF is on reverse
dmel.X.ann$Allele3 <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(Allele3=="A" & REF_fwd!=REF,"T",ifelse(Allele3=="C" & REF_fwd!=REF,"G",ifelse(Allele3=="G" & REF_fwd!=REF,"C",ifelse(Allele3=="T" & REF_fwd!=REF,"A",Allele3)))))
# Third alternative allele
dmel.X.ann$Allele4 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(dmel.X.ann$V4), split = ","), function(x) if (length(x) >= 3) x[3] else "")
# Convert allele to its complement if REF is on reverse
dmel.X.ann$Allele4 <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(Allele4=="A" & REF_fwd!=REF,"T",ifelse(Allele4=="C" & REF_fwd!=REF,"G",ifelse(Allele4=="G" & REF_fwd!=REF,"C",ifelse(Allele4=="T" & REF_fwd!=REF,"A",Allele4)))))

# Get SIFT scores for each alternative allele
dmel.X.ann$SIFT2 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(dmel.X.ann$V8), split = ","), function(x) if (length(x) >= 1) x[1] else "")
dmel.X.ann$SIFT3 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(dmel.X.ann$V8), split = ","), function(x) if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else "")
dmel.X.ann$SIFT4 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(dmel.X.ann$V8), split = ","), function(x) if (length(x) >= 3) x[3] else "")

# Assign SIFT score to each base (if the base is REF, the SIFT score is 1)
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_A <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(REF=="A",1,ifelse(Allele2=="A",SIFT2,ifelse(Allele3=="A",SIFT3,ifelse(Allele4=="A",SIFT4,NA)))))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_A <- as.numeric(as.character(dmel.X.ann$SIFT_A))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_T <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(REF=="T",1,ifelse(Allele2=="T",SIFT2,ifelse(Allele3=="T",SIFT3,ifelse(Allele4=="T",SIFT4,NA)))))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_T <- as.numeric(as.character(dmel.X.ann$SIFT_T))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_C <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(REF=="C",1,ifelse(Allele2=="C",SIFT2,ifelse(Allele3=="C",SIFT3,ifelse(Allele4=="C",SIFT4,NA)))))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_C <- as.numeric(as.character(dmel.X.ann$SIFT_C))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_G <- with(dmel.X.ann,ifelse(REF=="G",1,ifelse(Allele2=="G",SIFT2,ifelse(Allele3=="G",SIFT3,ifelse(Allele4=="G",SIFT4,NA)))))
dmel.X.ann$SIFT_G <- as.numeric(as.character(dmel.X.ann$SIFT_G))

# Remove duplicates
dmel.X.ann <- dmel.X.ann[!duplicated(dmel.X.ann[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID")]),]

# Final version
dmel.X.ann <- dmel.X.ann[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","REF","REF_fwd","Transcript","Gene","Flybase","Flybase_prot","Degeneracy","PROT_A","PROT_T","PROT_C","PROT_G","SIFT_A","SIFT_T","SIFT_C","SIFT_G")]
```

### Recombination rates

#### X chromosome

```{r}
#Import recombination rates
rr <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/metadata/recombination_rate/Dmelanogaster-Crossover-Rates-All-Chromosomes-100kb.R5.csv"))
# Subset to only include informative columns
rr <- rr[,c(2:4,7:9,12:14,17:19,22:24)]
names(rr) <- rep(c("Chrom","Midpoint","cM_Mb"),5)
# Transform to long format
rr.X <- rr[,1:3]
# Clean up recombination rate values
rr.X$Start <- rr.X$Midpoint-49999 
rr.X$End <- rr.X$Midpoint+50001
rr.X <- subset(rr.X,Chrom!="")
rr.X$Chrom <- "X"
rr.X$RR_bin <- paste(rr.X$Chrom,1:nrow(rr.X),sep = "_")
# For X-linked sites, multiply recombination rate values by 2/3rds to ensure a like-for-like comparison with autosomes (recombination rate values are derived from females and the male X does not recombine)
rr.X$cM_Mb <- rr.X$cM_Mb*2/3
```

#### Autosomes

```{r}
# Add recombination rate bins
rr <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/metadata/recombination_rate/Dmelanogaster-Crossover-Rates-All-Chromosomes-100kb.R5.csv"))
# Subset to only include informative columns
rr <- rr[,c(2:4,7:9,12:14,17:19,22:24)]
names(rr) <- rep(c("Chrom","Midpoint","cM_Mb"),5)
# Transform to long format
rr.A <- rbind(rr[,4:6],rr[,7:9],rr[,10:12],rr[,13:15])
# Clean up recombination rate values
rr.A$Start <- rr.A$Midpoint-49999
rr.A$End <- rr.A$Midpoint+50001
rr.A <- subset(rr.A,Chrom!="")
rr.A$Chrom <- as.factor(rr.A$Chrom)
levels(rr.A$Chrom) <- c("2L","2R","3L","3R")
rr.A$RR_bin[rr.A$Chrom=="2L"] <- paste(rr.A$Chrom[rr.A$Chrom=="2L"],1:nrow(subset(rr.A,Chrom=="2L")),sep = "_")
rr.A$RR_bin[rr.A$Chrom=="2R"] <- paste(rr.A$Chrom[rr.A$Chrom=="2R"],1:nrow(subset(rr.A,Chrom=="2R")),sep = "_")
rr.A$RR_bin[rr.A$Chrom=="3L"] <- paste(rr.A$Chrom[rr.A$Chrom=="3L"],1:nrow(subset(rr.A,Chrom=="3L")),sep = "_")
rr.A$RR_bin[rr.A$Chrom=="3R"] <- paste(rr.A$Chrom[rr.A$Chrom=="3R"],1:nrow(subset(rr.A,Chrom=="3R")),sep = "_")
# For autosomal sites, multiply recombination rate values by 1/2
rr.A$cM_Mb <- rr.A$cM_Mb*1/2
```

```{r}
#Import sex-biased gene expression table from Fraisse et al. 2019
```

### Polymorphism

We download *D. melanogaster* polymorphism data and created VCF, containing CDS-only sequences, from fasta files provided on John Pool's website. Individual vcfs have been called and mapped to the *D. melanogaster* assembly #5. Repeats and admixture tracts have been masked. SNPs were then called using snp-sites, and non-CDS regions removed using the *D. melanogaster* gff file.

```{r, engine = 'bash'}
# Download sequences from https://www.johnpool.net/genomes.html

# Filter out admixture and IBD tracts 
# For each chromosome arm, copy masking files to each folder containing .seq files, then
perl ibd_mask_seq.pl
perl admixture_mask_seq.pl 

# Make .seq files into fasta files

# For each chromosome arm, Rename ".seq" file names to ".fas"
for i in *.seq; do awk 'BEGIN{print ">'$i'"}1' $i > $i.fas; rm $i; done; 
mkdir misc; 
mv Table* misc/; mv dataslice.pl misc/; mv ibd* misc/; mv admixture* misc/; 
# Delete fasta files which are under 20 bytes - these have not made it through the admixture/ibd filtering
find . -name "*.fas" -size -20c -delete
# For each chromosome arm, concatenate FASTA files from each individual
cat *.fas > dmel_dpgp3_2L.fas;
cat *.fas > dmel_dpgp3_2R.fas;
cat *.fas > dmel_dpgp3_3L.fas;
cat *.fas > dmel_dpgp3_3R.fas;
cat *.fas > dmel_dpgp3_X.fas;

# Create VCF
snp-sites -v -o dmel_dpgp3_2L.vcf dmel_dpgp3_2L.fas;
snp-sites -v -o dmel_dpgp3_2R.vcf dmel_dpgp3_2R.fas;
snp-sites -v -o dmel_dpgp3_3L.vcf dmel_dpgp3_3L.fas;
```

#### Clean coding polymorphisms

##### X chromosome

```{r}
## Allele counts for coding polymorphisms in D. melanogaster
dmel.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/processing/allele_frequencies/dmel_dpgp3_X_fixedchrom2_clippedinterCDS_names_id.frq.count"),fill=T,h=F,skip=1,col.names = 1:9)
# Clean column names
names(dmel.X) <- c("Chrom","Pos","N_alleles","N_chr","V1","V2","V3","V4","V5")
dmel.X$Pos <- as.numeric(as.character(dmel.X$Pos))
dmel.X$ID <- paste(dmel.X$Chrom,dmel.X$Pos,sep="_")
# Remove duplicated rows
dmel.X <- dmel.X[!duplicated(dmel.X),]
# Clean allele count columns
# If the value is blank, replace with "*:0", which indicates that there were 0 missing alleles 
dmel.X$V1[dmel.X$V1==""] <- "*:0"
dmel.X$V2[dmel.X$V2==""] <- "*:0"
dmel.X$V3[dmel.X$V3==""] <- "*:0"
dmel.X$V4[dmel.X$V4==""] <- "*:0"
dmel.X$V5[dmel.X$V5==""] <- "*:0"
dmel.X$Allele1 <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V1),split = ":"))[,1]
dmel.X$Count1 <- as.numeric(do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V1),split = ":"))[,2])
dmel.X$Allele2 <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V2),split = ":"))[,1]
dmel.X$Count2 <- as.numeric(do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V2),split = ":"))[,2])
dmel.X$Allele3 <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V3),split = ":"))[,1]
dmel.X$Count3 <- as.numeric(do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V3),split = ":"))[,2])
dmel.X$Allele4 <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V4),split = ":"))[,1]
dmel.X$Count4 <- as.numeric(do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V4),split = ":"))[,2])
dmel.X$Allele5 <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V5),split = ":"))[,1]
dmel.X$Count5 <- as.numeric(do.call(rbind,strsplit(as.character(dmel.X$V5),split = ":"))[,2])
# Remove previous allele count columns and keep clean ones
dmel.X <- dmel.X[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","N_alleles","N_chr","Allele1","Count1","Allele2","Count2","Allele3","Count3","Allele4","Count4","Allele5","Count5")]
# Identify which allele is missing, so that allele frequencies can later be calculated as N_allele/(total_N-missing_N)
dmel.X$Missing_allele <- ifelse(dmel.X$Allele1=="*","Allele1",ifelse(dmel.X$Allele2=="*","Allele2",ifelse(dmel.X$Allele3=="*","Allele3",ifelse(dmel.X$Allele4=="*","Allele4",ifelse(dmel.X$Allele5=="*","Allele5","None")))))
# Total allele counts without missing alleles
dmel.X$AN <- with(dmel.X,ifelse(Missing_allele=="Allele2",N_chr-Count2,ifelse(Missing_allele=="Allele3",N_chr-Count3,ifelse(Missing_allele=="Allele4",N_chr-Count4,ifelse(Missing_allele=="Allele5",N_chr-Count5,NA)))))
# Frequency of first allele (not necessarily the reference, since the multiple sequence alignment does not include the reference line)
dmel.X$Allele1_F <- dmel.X$Count1/dmel.X$AN
# Frequency of minor allele
dmel.X$MAF <- ifelse(dmel.X$Allele1_F<0.5,dmel.X$Allele1_F,1-dmel.X$Allele1_F)
# Remove non-polymorphic sites (there shouldn't be any)
dmel.X <- subset(dmel.X,MAF>0)
# Keep only bi-allelic sites (site must have 3 alleles or fewer, and the 3 alleles cannot all be A/T/C/G, i.e. one must be missing) 
dmel.X <- subset(dmel.X,N_alleles<4 & !(Allele1 %in% c("A","T","C","G") & Allele2 %in% c("A","T","C","G") & Allele3 %in% c("A","T","C","G")))
# Identify non-missing allele
dmel.X$AlleleAlt <- with(dmel.X,ifelse(Missing_allele=="Allele2",Allele3,ifelse(Missing_allele=="Allele3",Allele2,NA)))
# Keep only sites with at least 150 informative alleles (~80% coverage)
dmel.X <- subset(dmel.X,AN>150)
# Subset to relevant columns
dmel.X <- dmel.X[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","Allele1_F","MAF","Allele1","AlleleAlt","AN")]
```

### Divergence (three-way)

```{r, engine='bash'}
#D. yakuba gff and fasta downloaded from: https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/016/746/365/GCF_016746365.2_Prin_Dyak_Tai18E2_2.1/
#Download gff for Drosophila simulans from reference genome #2 from: https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/754/195/GCF_000754195.2_ASM75419v2/
#Download gff and fasta for D. melanogaster from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/001/215/GCF_000001215.2_Release_5/


## Find orthologous genes

# Using protein alignments, keep only the longest transcript for each gene and keep only the gene name in the header

# Correct some lines in gff file for D. melanogaster
grep -v "?\t" GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic.gff > GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic_corrected.gff;

#D. melanogaster
# Get spliced CDS regions and protein alignments for each transcript (taking into account strand and phase)
gffread -S -y dmel_protein.fa -W -x dmel_transcripts.fa -g ../GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic.fna ../gff/GCF_000001215.2_Release_5_genomic_corrected.gff -F --keep-exon-attrs;
# For each gene (protein sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' dmel_protein.fa > dmel_protein.simple.header.fa
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t", (N++ ? "\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' dmel_protein.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > dmel_protein.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa
# For each gene (DNA sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' dmel_transcripts.fa > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.fa
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t", (N++ ? "\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' dmel_transcripts.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa

# D. simulans
gffread -S -y dsim_protein.fa -W -x dsim_transcripts.fa -g ../GCF_000754195.2_ASM75419v2_genomic.fna ../gff/GCF_000754195.2_ASM75419v2_genomic.gff -F --keep-exon-attrs;
# For each gene (protein sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' dsim_protein.fa > dsim_protein.simple.header.fa
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t", (N++ ? "\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' dsim_protein.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > dsim_protein.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa
# For each gene (DNA sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' dsim_transcripts.fa > dsim_transcripts.simple.header.fa
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t", (N++ ? "\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' dsim_transcripts.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa

# D. yakuba
gffread -S -y dyak_protein.fa -W -x dyak_transcripts.fa -g ../GCF_016746365.2_Prin_Dyak_Tai18E2_2.1_genomic.fna ../gff/GCF_016746365.2_Prin_Dyak_Tai18E2_2.1_genomic.gff -F --keep-exon-attrs;
# For each gene (protein sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' dyak_protein.fa > dyak_protein.simple.header.fa
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t", (N++ ? "\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' dyak_protein.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > dyak_protein.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa
# For each gene (DNA sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' dyak_transcripts.fa > dyak_transcripts.simple.header.fa
awk '/^>/ {printf("%s%s\t", (N++ ? "\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' dyak_transcripts.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa


# Get 1:1:1 orthologues using OrthoFinder
# Check orthofinder_dmel_dsim_dyak_v3.sh

# Make sure now to change output file formats from dos format to unix format by typing ":set ff=unix" in vim !!!

# List of single-copy orthologues in each species
join -1 1 -2 1 -o 2.2 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > dmel_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt;
join -1 1 -2 1 -o 2.3 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > dsim_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt;
join -1 1 -2 1 -o 2.4 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt; 
join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 1 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > dmel_dsim_dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt;

## Extract spliced CDS DNA sequences from the fasta file of each species

# List of gene IDs for each species
grep "^>" dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;
grep "^>" dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;
grep "^>" dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;

# Subset orthologs to only include those that appear in all the 3 species' fasta files
join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 2 ../../dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs <(sort -k2,2 dmel_dsim_dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) | sort -k3,3 | join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 3 ../../dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs - | sort -k4,4 | join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 4 ../../dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs - > dmel_dsim_dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;
cut -f3 dmel_dsim_dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt > dmel_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;
cut -f2 dmel_dsim_dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt > dsim_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;
cut -f1 dmel_dsim_dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt > dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;

# Subset fasta files to only include orthologs that appear in all the 3 species' fasta files
seqkit grep -f ../orthologues/Orthogroups/dmel_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa;
seqkit grep -f ../orthologues/Orthogroups/dsim_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa > dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa;
seqkit grep -f ../orthologues/Orthogroups/dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa > dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa;

# Order files by ID list
awk -v idfile="../orthologues/Orthogroups/dmel_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt" 'BEGIN{while((getline line<idfile)>0){id=line; ids[id]=1; order[++c]=id}} /^>/{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; split(substr($0,2),h,/[\t ]/); seq_id=h[1]; rec=$0"\n"; next} {rec=rec $0 "\n"} END{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; for(i=1;i<=c;i++) if(order[i] in seqs) printf "%s", seqs[order[i]]}' dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;
awk -v idfile="../orthologues/Orthogroups/dsim_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt" 'BEGIN{while((getline line<idfile)>0){id=line; ids[id]=1; order[++c]=id}} /^>/{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; split(substr($0,2),h,/[\t ]/); seq_id=h[1]; rec=$0"\n"; next} {rec=rec $0 "\n"} END{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; for(i=1;i<=c;i++) if(order[i] in seqs) printf "%s", seqs[order[i]]}' dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa > dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;
awk -v idfile="../orthologues/Orthogroups/dyak_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt" 'BEGIN{while((getline line<idfile)>0){id=line; ids[id]=1; order[++c]=id}} /^>/{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; split(substr($0,2),h,/[\t ]/); seq_id=h[1]; rec=$0"\n"; next} {rec=rec $0 "\n"} END{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; for(i=1;i<=c;i++) if(order[i] in seqs) printf "%s", seqs[order[i]]}' dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa > dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;

# Linearise fasta 
seqkit seq -w 0 dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa;
seqkit seq -w 0 dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa > dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa;
seqkit seq -w 0 dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa > dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa;

# Remove intermediate files
rm *_protein.simple.header.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;

#A list of single-copy orthologue transcripts that is useful for future filtering
grep "^>" dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.transcriptIDs;

# Split fastas into single genes
split -l 2 -a 5 dmel_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa dmel_genes_fastas/gene_;
split -l 2 -a 5 dsim_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa dsim_genes_fastas/gene_;
split -l 2 -a 5 dyak_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa dyak_genes_fastas/gene_;

# Concatenate genes by species
for i in gene_*; do cat $i ../dsim_genes_fastas/$i ../dyak_genes_fastas/$i > ../concatenated_orthogroups/$i; done
for i in gene_*; do mv "$i" "$i.fa"; done
for i in *.fa; do mv $i $(head -1 $i | sed 's/^>//').fa; done

# Align with MACSE
# check dmel_dsim_dyak_alignments.sh

# Convert fasta to vcf
# check msa_to_vcf_mmus_mspr_mpah.sh

# Concatenate vcf files
awk 'FNR > 1' concatenated_orthogroups_vcf/* > dmel_dsim_dyak.all_transcripts.vcf

# Only keep positions where there is a perfect match with degenotate output (some mismatch occurs because there is a big mismatch in length of the 3 species' transcripts, causing alignments to fail; others because of something is funny with "rna-ND4" transcript). Note that we are matching with the alleles that are transcripbed
awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} NR==FNR {k=$1 FS $2; a[k]=$0; next} {k=$1 FS $2; if(k in a) print $0, a[k]}' <(awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $4, $3, $1, $6}' ../degenotate_v2/degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n) <(sort -k1,1 -k2,2n dmel_dsim_dyak.all_transcripts.vcf) | awk 'BEGIN { FS=OFS="\t" } { $3 = toupper($3); if ($3 == $9) print $8, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5 }' > dmel_dsim_dyak.all_transcripts.degenotate_matching.vcf

#Subset to autosomes and X
grep -E "NT_033779\.4|NT_033778\.3|NT_037436\.3|NT_033777\.2" dmel_dsim_dyak.all_transcripts.degenotate_matching.vcf > dmel_dsim_dyak.chrAUTO.degenotate_matching.vcf;
grep "NC_004354.3" dmel_dsim_dyak.all_transcripts.degenotate_matching.vcf > dmel_dsim_dyak.chrX.degenotate_matching.vcf;
```

```{r}
dmel_dsim_dyak.X <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/processing/divergence/dmel_dsim_dyak.chrX.degenotate_matching.vcf"))
```

### Merge polymorphism, substitutions and annotations

By merging annotation, polymorphism and substitution data, we can identify mutations that are associated with each polymorphism and substitution. We also calculate the derived allele frequency of the mutation (i.e., for simplicity, the frequency of the allele that is not found in the outgroup). We remove sites with missing information. We calculate the Grantham score for each mutation (polymorphic or divergent).

##### D. sim divergence (three-way alignment)

###### X chromosome

```{r}
# Merge all sites
dmel.X.m <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x,y,all.x=T,by=c("Chrom","Pos","ID")),list(dmel.X.ann[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","REF","REF_fwd","Gene","Transcript","Flybase","Flybase_prot","Degeneracy","PROT_A","PROT_T","PROT_C","PROT_G","SIFT_A","SIFT_T","SIFT_C","SIFT_G")],dmel_dsim_dyak.X[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","SIM","YAK")],dmel.X[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","Allele1_F","MAF","Allele1","AlleleAlt","AN")])) 
#rm(dmel.X.ann)
#rm(dmel.X)
#rm(dmel_dsim_dyak.X)

#Identify amino-acid change for each mutated site (divergent)
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                         ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_T,dmel.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_T,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                     ifelse(((SIM=="C" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="C")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_C,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
# For polymorphism data, bases are always reported relative to the forward strand 
# But if transcription happens on the reverse strand, we need the bases to be the complement
# Therefore, we take the complement whenever there is a mismatch between the referencegenome  base and the base used when predicting open reading frames
dmel.X.m$Allele1 <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="C","G",Allele1)))))
dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="C","G",AlleleAlt)))))
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_T,dmel.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_T,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_C,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
#Derived allele frequency (frequency of allele that is not SIM, provided that SIM is not missing, and that one of the polymorphic alleles is equivalent to the reference allele)
dmel.X.m$DAF <- ifelse(dmel.X.m$SIM %in% c("A","T","G","C") & dmel.X.m$SIM==dmel.X.m$YAK & (dmel.X.m$REF==dmel.X.m$Allele1|dmel.X.m$REF==dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt) & dmel.X.m$Allele1==dmel.X.m$SIM,1-dmel.X.m$Allele1_F,ifelse(dmel.X.m$SIM %in% c("A","T","G","C") & dmel.X.m$SIM==dmel.X.m$YAK & (dmel.X.m$REF==dmel.X.m$Allele1|dmel.X.m$REF==dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt) & dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt==dmel.X.m$SIM,dmel.X.m$Allele1_F,NA))
# Identify Grantham score associated with each mutation
dmel.X.m$Grantham_divergent[!is.na(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent[!is.na(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
dmel.X.m$Grantham_polymorphic[!is.na(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic[!is.na(dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# SIFT score for each mutation
dmel.X.m$SIFT_divergent <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                     ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                            ifelse(((SIM=="C" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))
dmel.X.m$SIFT_polymorphic <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                              ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))

# Split sites into RR bins and record value of RR
dmel.X.m <- dmel.X.m[order(dmel.X.m$Chrom,dmel.X.m$Pos),]
dmel.X.m$RR_bin <- paste(dmel.X.m$Chrom,cut(dmel.X.m$Pos, breaks = rr.X$Start,include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE,labels=F),sep="_")
dmel.X.m <- merge(dmel.X.m,rr.X[,c("Chrom","RR_bin","cM_Mb")],by=c("Chrom","RR_bin"),all.x=T)

# GC-conservative status
dmel.X.m$GC_conservative <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("A","T") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & SIM %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("A","T") & SIM %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) ,1,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("T","A") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & SIM %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("G","C") & SIM %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)),0,NA)))

#Sex bias gene expression status
dmel.X.m <- merge(dmel.X.m,sbge_small,by=c("Flybase"),all.x=T)

#Gene age 
dmel.X.m <- merge(dmel.X.m,gene.age,by=c("Flybase_prot"),all.x=T)
dmel.X.m <- dmel.X.m[order(dmel.X.m$Chrom,dmel.X.m$Pos),]

# Remove duplicates
dmel.X.m <- dmel.X.m[!duplicated(dmel.X.m[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID")]),]

write.table(dmel.X.m,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")
```

```{r}
# Merge all sites
dmel.A.m <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x,y,all.x=T,by=c("Chrom","Pos","ID")),list(dmel.A.ann[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","REF","REF_fwd","Gene","Transcript","Flybase","Flybase_prot","Degeneracy","PROT_A","PROT_T","PROT_C","PROT_G","SIFT_A","SIFT_T","SIFT_C","SIFT_G")],dmel_dsim_dyak.A[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","SIM","YAK")],dmel.A[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","Allele1_F","MAF","Allele1","AlleleAlt","AN")])) 
#rm(dmel.A.ann)
#rm(dmel.A)
#rm(dmel_dsim_dyak.A)

#Identify amino-acid change for each mutated site (divergent)
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                         ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                     ifelse(((SIM=="C" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="C")),paste(PROT_C,PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
# For polymorphism data, bases are always reported relative to the forward strand 
# But if transcription happens on the reverse strand, we need the bases to be the complement
# Therefore, we take the complement whenever there is a mismatch between the referencegenome  base and the base used when predicting open reading frames
dmel.A.m$Allele1 <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="C","G",Allele1)))))
dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="C","G",AlleleAlt)))))
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),paste(PROT_C,PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
#Derived allele frequency (frequency of allele that is not SIM, provided that SIM is not missing, and that one of the polymorphic alleles is equivalent to the reference allele)
dmel.A.m$DAF <- ifelse(dmel.A.m$SIM %in% c("A","T","G","C") & dmel.A.m$SIM==dmel.A.m$YAK & (dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$Allele1|dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt) & dmel.A.m$Allele1==dmel.A.m$SIM,1-dmel.A.m$Allele1_F,ifelse(dmel.A.m$SIM %in% c("A","T","G","C") & dmel.A.m$SIM==dmel.A.m$YAK & (dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$Allele1|dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt) & dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt==dmel.A.m$SIM,dmel.A.m$Allele1_F,NA))
# Identify Grantham score associated with each mutation
dmel.A.m$Grantham_divergent[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
dmel.A.m$Grantham_polymorphic[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# SIFT score for each mutation
dmel.A.m$SIFT_divergent <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                     ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                            ifelse(((SIM=="C" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))
dmel.A.m$SIFT_polymorphic <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                              ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))

# Split sites into RR bins and record value of RR
dmel.A.m <- dmel.A.m[order(dmel.A.m$Chrom,dmel.A.m$Pos),]
dmel.A.m$RR_bin <- paste(dmel.A.m$Chrom,cut(dmel.A.m$Pos, breaks = rr.X$Start,include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE,labels=F),sep="_")
dmel.A.m <- merge(dmel.A.m,rr.X[,c("Chrom","RR_bin","cM_Mb")],by=c("Chrom","RR_bin"),all.x=T)

# GC-conservative status
dmel.A.m$GC_conservative <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("A","T") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & SIM %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("A","T") & SIM %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) ,1,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("T","A") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & SIM %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("G","C") & SIM %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)),0,NA)))

#Sex bias gene expression status
dmel.A.m <- merge(dmel.A.m,sbge_small,by=c("Flybase"),all.x=T)

#Gene age 
dmel.A.m <- merge(dmel.A.m,gene.age,by=c("Flybase_prot"),all.x=T)
dmel.A.m <- dmel.A.m[order(dmel.A.m$Chrom,dmel.A.m$Pos),]
```

```{r}
dmel.A.m$Allele1 <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="C","G",Allele1)))))
dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="C","G",AlleleAlt)))))
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),paste(PROT_C,PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
#Derived allele frequency (frequency of allele that is not YAK, provided that YAK is not missing, and that one of the polymorphic alleles is equivalent to the reference allele)
dmel.A.m$DAF <- ifelse(dmel.A.m$YAK %in% c("A","T","G","C") & (dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$Allele1|dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt) & dmel.A.m$Allele1==dmel.A.m$YAK,1-dmel.A.m$Allele1_F,ifelse(dmel.A.m$YAK %in% c("A","T","G","C") & (dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$Allele1|dmel.A.m$REF==dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt) & dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt==dmel.A.m$YAK,dmel.A.m$Allele1_F,NA))
# Identify Grantham score associated with each mutation
dmel.A.m$Grantham_divergent[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
dmel.A.m$Grantham_polymorphic[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic[!is.na(dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# SIFT score for each mutation
dmel.A.m$SIFT_divergent <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="T")|(YAK=="T" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="C")|(YAK=="C" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                       ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                              ifelse(((YAK=="T" & REF=="C")|(YAK=="C" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                     ifelse(((YAK=="T" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                            ifelse(((YAK=="C" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))
dmel.A.m$SIFT_polymorphic <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                              ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))

# Split sites into RR bins and record value of RR
dmel.A.m <- dmel.A.m[order(dmel.A.m$Chrom,dmel.A.m$Pos),]
dmel.A.m$RR_bin <- paste(dmel.A.m$Chrom,cut(dmel.A.m$Pos, breaks = rr.X$Start,include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE,labels=F),sep="_")
dmel.A.m <- merge(dmel.A.m,rr.X[,c("Chrom","RR_bin","cM_Mb")],by=c("Chrom","RR_bin"),all.x=T)

# GC-conservative status
dmel.A.m$GC_conservative <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("A","T") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & YAK %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("A","T") & YAK %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) ,1,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("T","A") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & YAK %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("G","C") & YAK %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)),0,NA)))

#Sex bias gene expression status
dmel.A.m <- merge(dmel.A.m,sbge_small,by=c("Flybase"),all.x=T)

#Gene age 
dmel.A.m <- merge(dmel.A.m,gene.age,by=c("Flybase_prot"),all.x=T)
dmel.A.m <- dmel.A.m[order(dmel.A.m$Chrom,dmel.A.m$Pos),]

# Remove duplicates
dmel.A.m <- dmel.A.m[!duplicated(dmel.A.m[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID")]),]

write.table(dmel.A.m,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dyak_outgroup"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")
```

### Mutational target size

#### Export

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"),h=T)
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"),h=T)

# For each site, create every possible amino acid pair
# X chromosome
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_AT <- paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_T,sep="_")
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_AC <- paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_AG <- paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_A,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_TC <- paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_T,dmel.X.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_TG <- paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_T,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
dmel.X.m$Mutation_type_CG <- paste(dmel.X.m$PROT_C,dmel.X.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
# Autosomes
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_AT <- paste(dmel.A.m$PROT_A,dmel.A.m$PROT_T,sep="_")
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_AC <- paste(dmel.A.m$PROT_A,dmel.A.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_AG <- paste(dmel.A.m$PROT_A,dmel.A.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_TC <- paste(dmel.A.m$PROT_T,dmel.A.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_TG <- paste(dmel.A.m$PROT_T,dmel.A.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
dmel.A.m$Mutation_type_CG <- paste(dmel.A.m$PROT_C,dmel.A.m$PROT_G,sep="_")

# Number of sites
CDS_length <- nrow(dmel.X.m)+nrow(dmel.A.m)

# Frequency of each base
A_freq <- sum(dmel.X.m$REF=="A",dmel.A.m$REF=="A")/CDS_length
T_freq <- sum(dmel.X.m$REF=="T",dmel.A.m$REF=="T")/CDS_length
C_freq <- sum(dmel.X.m$REF=="C",dmel.A.m$REF=="C")/CDS_length
G_freq <- sum(dmel.X.m$REF=="G",dmel.A.m$REF=="G")/CDS_length

# How likely is a given base to mutate to another base, given base composition and 2:1 transition to transversion rate ratio (from Keightley et al. 2009), or a 1:1 ratio of counts
ts_tv <- 1
tv_mult <- 1 / (2 * (1 + ts_tv))
ts_mult <- ts_tv / (1 * (1 + ts_tv))
  
# Compute probabilities
mutation_probs <- c(
    Mutation_type_AT = (A_freq + T_freq) * tv_mult,
    Mutation_type_AC = (A_freq + C_freq) * tv_mult,
    Mutation_type_AG = (A_freq + G_freq) * ts_mult,
    Mutation_type_TC = (T_freq + C_freq) * ts_mult,
    Mutation_type_TG = (T_freq + G_freq) * tv_mult,
    Mutation_type_CG = (C_freq + G_freq) * tv_mult
)

nonsyn_amino_target <- c()
nonsyn_amino_AT_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_AC_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_AG_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_TC_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_TG_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_CG_prob <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)) {
  # Count the number of mutations that result in a given nonsynonymous amino acid pair (unweighted by ts:tv ratio or base composition)
  count_AT <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_AC <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_AG <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_TC <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_TG <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_CG <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  
  # Weight counts of mutations that result in a given nonsynonymous amino acid pair by mutation probabilities (that take into account ts:tv ratio and base composition)
  weighted_sum <- count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"] +
    count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"] +
    count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"] +
    count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"] +
    count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"] +
    count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]
  
  # For each nonsynonymous amino acid pair, count total occurrences and divide by the total number of sites, to obtain mutational target size across the coding sequence
  nonsyn_amino_target[i] <- weighted_sum / CDS_length
  
  # Calculate probability that amino acid pair occurs due to a given base pairing (taking into account ts:tv ratio and base composition)
  nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i] <- (count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i] <- (count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i] <- (count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i] <- (count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i] <- (count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i] <- (count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"]) / weighted_sum
  
  print(i)
}


# Now for synonymous sites
syn_amino_target <- c()
syn_amino_AT_target <- c()
syn_amino_AC_target <- c()
syn_amino_AG_target <- c()
syn_amino_TC_target <- c()
syn_amino_TG_target <- c()
syn_amino_CG_target <- c()
for (i in 1:length(syn_amino)) {
  # Count the number of mutations that result in a given synonymous amino acid pair (unweighted by ts:tv ratio or base composition)
  count_AT <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_AC <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_AG <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_TC <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_TG <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_CG <- sum(as.matrix(dmel.X.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(dmel.A.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == syn_amino[i])
  
  # Weight counts of mutations that result in a given synonymous amino acid pair by mutation probabilities (that take into account ts:tv ratio and base composition)
  weighted_sum <- count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"] +
    count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"] +
    count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"] +
    count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"] +
    count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"] +
    count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]
  
  # For each synonsmous amino acid pair, count total occurrences and divide by the total number of sites, to obtain mutational target size for given nonsynonymous amino acid pair
  syn_amino_target[i] <- weighted_sum / CDS_length
  
  # Split mutation target size by different base pairings
  syn_amino_AT_target[i] <- (count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_AC_target[i] <- (count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_AG_target[i] <- (count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_TC_target[i] <- (count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_TG_target[i] <- (count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_CG_target[i] <- (count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"]) / CDS_length
  
  print(i)
}


dd <- data.frame(cbind(nonsyn_amino,nonsyn_amino_target,nonsyn_amino_AT_prob,nonsyn_amino_AC_prob,nonsyn_amino_AG_prob,nonsyn_amino_TC_prob,nonsyn_amino_TG_prob,nonsyn_amino_CG_prob))
dd$is_zerofold <- ifelse(dd$nonsyn_amino %in% zero_amino,1,0)
write.table(dd,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/nonsyn_amino_target.txt"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")

dd2 <- data.frame(cbind(syn_amino,syn_amino_target,syn_amino_AT_target,syn_amino_AC_target,syn_amino_AG_target,syn_amino_TC_target,syn_amino_TG_target,syn_amino_CG_target))
dd2$is_fourfold <- ifelse(dd2$syn_amino %in% four_amino,1,0)
write.table(dd2,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/syn_amino_target.txt"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")

zero_amino_target <- nonsyn_amino_target[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_AT_prob <- nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_AC_prob <- nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_AG_prob <- nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_TC_prob <- nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_TG_prob <- nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_CG_prob <- nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]

four_amino_target <- syn_amino_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_AT_target <- syn_amino_AT_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_AC_target <- syn_amino_AC_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_AG_target <- syn_amino_AG_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_TC_target <- syn_amino_TC_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_TG_target <- syn_amino_TG_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_CG_target <- syn_amino_CG_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]

rm(dmel.X.m)
rm(dmel.A.m)
```
