### MKT (mutation size)

### *D. sim* outgroup

#### Simple set-up

##### Nonsyn vs. syn

We can now set up a quick-and-dirty McDonald-Kreitman test for autosomes and X chromosomes, for each mutation type.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"))

dmel.X.m <- subset(dmel.X.m,!(is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic) & is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)))
dmel.A.m <- subset(dmel.A.m,!(is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic) & is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)))

Dn.A <- vector()
Pn.A <- vector()
Pn.common.A <- vector()
Dn.X <- vector()
Pn.X <- vector()
Pn.common.X <- vector()
Pn_Ps.A <- vector()
alpha.A <- vector()
alpha.A.FW <- vector()
alpha.X <- vector()
alpha.X.FW <- vector()
Pn_Ps.X <- vector()
omegaA.A <- vector()
omegaA.A.FW <- vector()
omegaA.X <- vector()
omegaA.X.FW <- vector()
omegaNA.A <- vector()
omegaNA.A.FW <- vector()
omegaNA.X <- vector()
omegaNA.X.FW <- vector()
granthams <- vector()

# Synonymous sites, autosomes
Ds.A <- nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Dn.A.overall <- nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Ps.A <- nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))
Ps.common.A <- nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))

# Synonymous sites, X
Ds.X <- nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Dn.X.overall <- nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Ps.X <- nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))
Ps.common.X <- nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))

c(Ds.A,Dn.A.overall,Ps.common.A,Ds.X,Dn.X.overall,Ps.common.X)

for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  
  granthams[i] <- as.numeric(subset(dmel.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent==nonsyn_amino[i])$Grantham_divergent[1])
  
  # Autosomes
  # Nonsynonymous sites
  Dn.A[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent==nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))))
  Pn.A[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt)  & DAF>0 & DAF<0.95 & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  Pn.common.A[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(dmel.A.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  
  # X chromosome
  # Nonsynonymous sites
  Dn.X[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, Mutation_type_divergent==nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))))
  Pn.X[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) &  DAF>0 & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  Pn.common.X[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(dmel.X.m, (SIM==Allele1 | SIM==AlleleAlt) &  DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  
  #Alpha values
  alpha.A[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.A))
  alpha.A.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.common.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.common.A))
  alpha.X[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.X))
  alpha.X.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.common.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.common.X))
  
  #OmegaA values
  omegaA.A[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaA.A.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.common.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.common.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaA.X[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  omegaA.X.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.common.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.common.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  
  #OmegaNA values
  omegaNA.A[i] <- (Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)-(1-(Ds.A*Pn.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaNA.A.FW[i] <- (Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)-(1-(Ds.A*Pn.common.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.common.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaNA.X[i] <- (Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)-(1-(Ds.X*Pn.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  omegaNA.X.FW[i] <- (Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)-(1-(Ds.X*Pn.common.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.common.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  
  # Pn/Ps values
  Pn_Ps.A[i] <- Pn.A[i]/Ps.A
  Pn_Ps.X[i] <- Pn.X[i]/Ps.X
  
  print(i)
}

#Prepare plots
dd <- as.data.frame(cbind(rep(granthams,2),c(alpha.X.FW,alpha.A.FW),c(omegaA.X.FW,omegaA.A.FW),c(omegaNA.X.FW,omegaNA.A.FW),c(Pn_Ps.X,Pn_Ps.A),c(rep("X",81),rep("A",81))))
names(dd) <- c("grantham_score","alpha","omegaA","omegaNA","Pn_over_Ps","chromosome")
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$grantham_score))
dd$alpha <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$alpha))
dd$omegaA <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$omegaA))
dd$omegaNA <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$omegaNA))
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$Pn_over_Ps))
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")
```

#### Grapes set-up

##### nonsyn vs. syn

###### unfolded SFS, old (no correction for differences in mut. target size)

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  dmel.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  dmel.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  write.table(dmel.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_old/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(dmel.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_old/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(nonsyn_amino),nonsyn_amino)),paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_old/config_old.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
```

###### unfolded SFS

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.X.m$REF_SIM <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                                         ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                                     ifelse(((SIM=="C" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.A.m$REF_SIM <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                     ifelse(((SIM=="C" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans")
dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans")

write.table(dmel.X.unfolded.dofe,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
write.table(dmel.A.unfolded.dofe,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)


grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   

  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
```

###### folded SFS

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.X.m$REF_SIM <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                                         ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",

                                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                              ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",

                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.A.m$REF_SIM <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="T")|(SIM=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((SIM=="A" & REF=="G")|(SIM=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((SIM=="T" & REF=="C")|(SIM=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",

  #1: Descriptor,

  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))

  return(m)
  }
  else{

          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),

  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),

  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
```

##### 0 vs. 4-fold

###### unfolded SFS, old (no correction for differences in mut. target size)

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"),h=T)
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"),h=T)

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences))),
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))),
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(zero_amino)){
  dmel.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  dmel.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  write.table(dmel.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_zerofour_old/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(dmel.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_zerofour_old/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(zero_amino),zero_amino)),paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_zerofour_old/config_zerofour_old.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
```

```{r}
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans")
```

```{r}
grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of zeroonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for zeroonymous mutations
  #4: zeroonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of fouronymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is fouronymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is fouronymous)+...). This procedure subsets the fouronymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given zeroonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for fouronymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: fouronymous SFS, # histogram of fouronymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given zeroonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of zeroonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of zeroonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given zeroonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of fouronymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of fouronymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given fouronymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given zeroonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i]& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   

  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(subset(df, SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>1)),
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
}
else{
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>1)),
          nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
}
}
```

```{r}
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>1 & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),

            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df, SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
```
