# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df, SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>-1 & SB<1 & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB>-1 & SB<1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB>-1 & SB<1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB>-1 & SB<1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.folded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.folded.dofe <- list()

  dmel.X.folded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  dmel.A.folded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)

This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)

            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB<=-1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB<=-1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB<=-1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB<=-1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB<=-1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB<=-1)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),

  }

            n_sequences,

            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df, SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB<=-1 & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & SB<=-1& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1)),
            nrow(subset(df,SB<=-1))*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_T" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="A_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_C" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="T_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SIM=="C_G" & is.na(DAF) & SB<=-1))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.folded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.folded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  dmel.X.folded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  dmel.A.folded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. simulans",iteration=i)
  write.table(dmel.X.folded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_fb/dmel.X.folded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(dmel.A.folded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_fb/dmel.A.folded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(nonsyn_amino),nonsyn_amino)),paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_fb/config_fb_folded.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)

#### Grapes import

##### nonsyn vs. syn

###### no correction for mutation target

```{r}
dd <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
dd.A <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_old/dmel_chrAUTO_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.A$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaExpo")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_old/dmel_chrX_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaExpo")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_old/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_old/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
tmpN.A <- c()
tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}
PiN_over_PiS <- do.call(rbind,PiN_over_PiS)
dd$PiN_over_PiS <- PiN_over_PiS
dd$target_size <- rep(nonsyn_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")

# Statistical tests
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.01816487, p = 0.8721
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.2116693, p = 0.05783
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaNA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.4540164, p = <0.001
```

dd.A$mutation_type <- zero_amino[i]

dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaExpo")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_zerofour/dmel_chrX_",zero_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- zero_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaExpo")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps 
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is replaced with 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0
# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
for (i in 1:length(zero_amino)){
pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_zerofour/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),skip=2)
pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_zerofour/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),skip=2)
tmpN.A <- c()
tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}
PiN_over_PiS <- do.call(rbind,PiN_over_PiS)
dd$PiN_over_PiS <- PiN_over_PiS
dd$target_size <- rep(zero_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$target_size[dd$chromosome=="X"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio","target_size")
dd2$alpha_ratio[dd2$alpha_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$omegaA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaNA_ratio[dd2$omegaNA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$target_size[dd$chromosome=="X"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio","target_size")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")

# Statistical tests
cor.test(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],method="spearman")
# rho = -0.5768812, p = 9.199e-08
cor.test(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],method="spearman")
# rho = -0.443985, p = 8.334e-05
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = 0.08727581, p = 0.4628
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.3296332, p = 0.004402
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaNA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.5174432, p = 3.25e-06
```

##### nonsyn vs. syn, UB

###### unfolded

```{r}
dd <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
dd.A <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_ub/dmel_chrAUTO_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.A$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaExpo")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_ub/dmel_chrX_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaExpo")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_ub/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/input_ub/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
tmpN.A <- c()
tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}
PiN_over_PiS <- do.call(rbind,PiN_over_PiS)
dd$PiN_over_PiS <- PiN_over_PiS
dd$target_size <- rep(nonsyn_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")
dd2$alpha_ratio[dd2$alpha_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$omegaA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")

# Statistical tests
cor.test(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],method="spearman")
# rho = -0.4354224, p = 4.854e-05
cor.test(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],method="spearman")
# rho = -0.3814181, p = 0.0004427
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.1225995, p = 0.2756
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.1457732, p = 0.1941
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaNA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.3339928, p = 0.005036
```

```{r}
dd <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
dd.A <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_mb/dmel_chrAUTO_folded_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.A$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaZero")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dsim/output_mb/dmel_chrX_folded_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaZero")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0
dd$target_size <- rep(nonsyn_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")
dd2$alpha_ratio[dd2$alpha_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$omegaA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaNA_ratio[dd2$omegaNA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")

cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.01451182, p = 0.8977
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaNA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.3655117, p = 0.001261

### *D. yak* outgroup

#### Grapes set-up

##### nonsyn vs. syn

###### unfolded SFS, old (no correction for differences in mut. target size)

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dyak_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dyak_outgroup"))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  dmel.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba",iteration=i)
  dmel.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba",iteration=i)
  write.table(dmel.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input_old/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(dmel.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input_old/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(nonsyn_amino),nonsyn_amino)),paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input_old/config_old.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
```

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dyak_outgroup"))

                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",

                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",

                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.X.m$REF_YAK <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="T")|(YAK=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="C")|(YAK=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",

dmel.A.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.A.m$REF_YAK <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="T")|(YAK=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="C")|(YAK=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((YAK=="T" & REF=="C")|(YAK=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                              ifelse(((YAK=="T" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                     ifelse(((YAK=="C" & REF=="G")|(YAK=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba")
dmel.A.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba")

            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),

    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

###### folded SFS

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dyak_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dyak_outgroup"))
dmel.X.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.X.m$REF_YAK <- with(dmel.X.m,ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="T")|(YAK=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",

                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
dmel.A.m$REF_YAK <- with(dmel.A.m,ifelse(((YAK=="A" & REF=="T")|(YAK=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.folded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba")
dmel.A.folded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba")

write.table(dmel.X.folded.dofe,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/dmel.X.folded.dofe"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
write.table(dmel.A.folded.dofe,paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/dmel.A.folded.dofe"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)


grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_YAK=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

dmel.X.folded.dofe <- list()
dmel.A.folded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  dmel.X.folded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba",iteration=i)
  dmel.A.folded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=dmel.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="D. melanogaster",outgroup="D. yakuba",iteration=i)
  write.table(dmel.X.folded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/dmel.X.folded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(dmel.A.folded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/dmel.A.folded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(nonsyn_amino),nonsyn_amino)),paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/config_folded.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)

```{r}
dd <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
dd.A <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/output/dmel_chrAUTO_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.A$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaExpo")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/output/dmel_chrX_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaExpo")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/dmel.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/grapes/dyak/input/dmel.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
tmpN.A <- c()
tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}
PiN_over_PiS <- do.call(rbind,PiN_over_PiS)
dd$PiN_over_PiS <- PiN_over_PiS
dd$target_size <- rep(nonsyn_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

### MKT (Phylostrata)

### *D. sim* outgroup

#### Grapes set-up

##### unfolded SFS

```{r}
dmel.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.X.m.dsim_outgroup"))
dmel.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"dmel/mkt/dmel.A.m.dsim_outgroup"))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(dmel.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_phylostrata <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & Phylostrata==i)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & Phylostrata==i)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Phylostrata==i)),
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Phylostrata==i)))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & Phylostrata==i)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & Phylostrata==i)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Phylostrata==i)),
            nrow(subset(df,Phylostrata==i))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Phylostrata==i)))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}
