### Polymorphism

We downloaded *M. musculus* polymorphism data and created a VCF, containing CDS-only sequences. Data was from wild populations, based on Harr et al. 2016, accessed from <https://wwwuser.gwdguser.de/~evolbio/evolgen/wildmouse/vcf/>

```{r, engine = 'bash'}

#M. musculus castaneus
# Only keep VCF lines that fall in CDS
bedtools intersect -a Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.vcf.gz -b ../CDS_intervals/mm10_CDS_intervals.bed -header > Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.vcf;
# Keep only relevant columns
bcftools query -f '%CHROM %POS %REF %ALT %INFO/AC %INFO/AN %INFO/AF\n' Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.vcf > Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf;
# Annotate polymorphic sites as synonymous or non-synonymous 
#java -jar ~/Downloads/snpEff/snpEff.jar mm10 Mmm_CZE.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.vcf | java -jar ~/Downloads/snpEff/SnpSift.jar extractFields - "CHROM" "POS" "ID" "REF" "ALT" "ANN[0].EFFECT" "ANN[0].GENE" "ANN[0].GENEID" "ANN[0].BIOTYPE" > Mmm_CZE.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.ann.vcf;
# Subset to Autosomes vs. X
grep "^chrX" Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf > chrX.Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf;
grep -e "^chr[0-9]" -e "^chr[0-9][0-9]" Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf > chrAUTO.Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf

```

#### Clean coding polymorphisms

##### X chromosome

```{r}
## Allele counts for coding polymorphisms in M. musculus
mmus.X <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/processing/allele_frequencies/chrX.Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf"),sep=" ",h=F)
# Clean column names
names(mmus.X) <- c("Chrom","Pos","Allele1","AlleleAlt","AC","AN","AlleleAlt_F")
mmus.X$Chrom <- "X"
mmus.X$Pos <- as.numeric(as.character(mmus.X$Pos))
mmus.X$ID <- paste(mmus.X$Chrom,mmus.X$Pos,sep="_")
# Remove duplicated rows
mmus.X <- mmus.X[!duplicated(mmus.X),]
# Frequency of minor allele
mmus.X$Allele1_F <- 1-as.numeric(as.character(mmus.X$AlleleAlt_F)) 
mmus.X$MAF <- ifelse(mmus.X$Allele1_F<0.5,mmus.X$Allele1_F,1-mmus.X$Allele1_F)
# Remove non-polymorphic sites (there shouldn't be any)
mmus.X <- subset(mmus.X,MAF>0)
# Remove sites with AN<15 (80% call rate)
mmus.X <- subset(mmus.X,AN>14)
# Remove PAR (positions taken from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/001/635/GCF_000001635.20_GRCm38/GCF_000001635.20_GRCm38_assembly_structure/genomic_regions_definitions.txt)
mmus.X <- subset(mmus.X,!((Pos>=90745845 & Pos<=91644698) | (Pos>=169969759 & Pos<=170931299)))
```

##### Autosomes

```{r}
## Allele counts for coding polymorphisms in M. musculus
mmus.A <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/processing/allele_frequencies/chrAUTO.Mmc_CAST.vcf_90_recalibrated_snps_raw_indels.env.ef.SNP.MNP.clippedinterCDS.simple.vcf"),sep=" ",h=F)
# Clean column names
names(mmus.A) <- c("Chrom","Pos","Allele1","AlleleAlt","AC","AN","AlleleAlt_F")
mmus.A$Chrom <- as.factor(as.character(mmus.A$Chrom))
levels(mmus.A$Chrom) <- c(1,10:19,2:9)
mmus.A$Pos <- as.numeric(as.character(mmus.A$Pos))
mmus.A$ID <- paste(mmus.A$Chrom,mmus.A$Pos,sep="_")
# Remove duplicated rows
mmus.A <- mmus.A[!duplicated(mmus.A),]
# Frequency of minor allele
mmus.A$Allele1_F <- 1-as.numeric(as.character(mmus.A$AlleleAlt_F)) 
mmus.A$MAF <- ifelse(mmus.A$Allele1_F<0.5,mmus.A$Allele1_F,1-mmus.A$Allele1_F)
# Remove non-polymorphic sites (there shouldn't be any)
mmus.A <- subset(mmus.A,MAF>0)
# Remove sites with AN<15
mmus.A <- subset(mmus.A,AN>14)
```

```{r}
# For each gene (protein sequence), only keep longest transcript 
gawk '/^>/ { if (match($0, /gene=([^;]+)/, a)) { gene = a[1]; header_rest = substr($0, 2); print ">" gene "|" header_rest; keep = 1 } else { keep = 0 }; next } keep { print }' mmus_protein.fa > mmus_protein.simple.header.fa;

"\n" : ""), $0); next} {printf("%s", $0)} END {print ""}' mmus_protein.simple.header.fa | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); gene = arr[1]; seq = $2; len = length(seq); print gene "\t" len "\t" $1 "\t" seq }' | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2nr | sort -t $'\t' -k1,1 --stable -u | cut -f 3,4 | awk 'BEGIN { FS="\t" }{ split($1, arr, "\\|"); split(arr[2], hdr_parts, " "); transcript_id = hdr_parts[1]; print ">" transcript_id; print $2 }' > mmus_protein.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa;

# Get 1:1:1 orthologues using OrthoFinder
# Check orthofinder_mmus_mspr_mpah.sh

# Make sure now to change output file formats from dos format to unix format by typing ":set ff=unix" in vim !!!

# List of single-copy orthologues in each species
join -1 1 -2 1 -o 2.2 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > mmus_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt;
join -1 1 -2 1 -o 2.4 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > mspr_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt; 
join -1 1 -2 1 -o 2.3 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) > mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt;
join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 1 <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) <(sort -k1,1 Orthogroups.tsv) | awk 'BEGIN{ FS=OFS="\t" }{print $1, $2, $4, $3}' > mmus_mspr_mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt;

## Extract spliced CDS DNA sequences from the fasta file of each species

# List of transcript IDs for each species, sorted
grep "^>" mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;
grep "^>" mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;
grep "^>" mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs;

# Subset orthologs to only include those that appear in all the 3 species' fasta files
join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 2 ../../mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs <(sort -k2,2 mmus_mspr_mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt) | sort -k3,3 | join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 3 ../../mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs - | sort -k4,4 | join -t $'\t' -1 1 -2 4 ../../mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.transcriptIDs - > mmus_mspr_mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;
cut -f3 mmus_mspr_mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt > mmus_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;
cut -f2 mmus_mspr_mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt > mspr_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;
cut -f1 mmus_mspr_mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt > mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt;

# Subset fasta files to only include orthologs that appear in all the 3 species' fasta files
seqkit grep -f orthologues/Orthogroups/mmus_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa > mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa;
seqkit grep -f orthologues/Orthogroups/mspr_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.fa > mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa;
seqkit grep -f orthologues/Orthogroups/mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa > mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa;

# Order files by ID list
awk -v idfile="orthologues/Orthogroups/mmus_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt" 'BEGIN{while((getline line<idfile)>0){id=line; ids[id]=1; order[++c]=id}} /^>/{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; split(substr($0,2),h,/[\t ]/); seq_id=h[1]; rec=$0"\n"; next} {rec=rec $0 "\n"} END{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; for(i=1;i<=c;i++) if(order[i] in seqs) printf "%s", seqs[order[i]]}' mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa > mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;
awk -v idfile="orthologues/Orthogroups/mspr_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt" 'BEGIN{while((getline line<idfile)>0){id=line; ids[id]=1; order[++c]=id}} /^>/{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; split(substr($0,2),h,/[\t ]/); seq_id=h[1]; rec=$0"\n"; next} {rec=rec $0 "\n"} END{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; for(i=1;i<=c;i++) if(order[i] in seqs) printf "%s", seqs[order[i]]}' mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa > mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;
awk -v idfile="orthologues/Orthogroups/mpah_SingleCopyOrthologues_in_gff.txt" 'BEGIN{while((getline line<idfile)>0){id=line; ids[id]=1; order[++c]=id}} /^>/{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; split(substr($0,2),h,/[\t ]/); seq_id=h[1]; rec=$0"\n"; next} {rec=rec $0 "\n"} END{if(seq_id!="" && seq_id in ids) seqs[seq_id]=rec; for(i=1;i<=c;i++) if(order[i] in seqs) printf "%s", seqs[order[i]]}' mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa > mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;

# Linearise fasta 
seqkit seq -w 0 mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa > mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa;
seqkit seq -w 0 mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa > mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa;
seqkit seq -w 0 mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa > mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa;

# Remove intermediate files
rm *_protein.simple.header.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;
rm *_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.fa; 
rm *_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.fa;

#A list of single-copy orthologue transcripts that is useful for future filtering
grep "^>" mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa | sed 's/^>//' | sort > mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.transcriptIDs;
awk -v OFS='\t' '{print NR, $0}' mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.transcriptIDs > config_mmus_mspr_mpah.txt;

# Split fastas into single genes
split -l 2 -a 5 mmus_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa mmus_genes_fastas/gene_;
split -l 2 -a 5 mspr_transcripts.simple.header2.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa mspr_genes_fastas/gene_;
split -l 2 -a 5 mpah_transcripts.simple.header.onlylongestCDS.singlecopyorthologue.ordered.linearised.fa mpah_genes_fastas/gene_;

# Concatenate genes by species
for i in gene_*; do cat $i ../mspr_genes_fastas/$i ../mpah_genes_fastas/$i > ../concatenated_orthogroups/$i; done
for i in gene_*; do mv "$i" "$i.fa"; done;
for i in *.fa; do mv $i $(head -1 $i | sed 's/^>//').fa; done;


# Align with MACSE
# Check mmus_mspr_mpah_alignments.sh

# Convert fasta to vcf
# Check msa_to_vcf_mmus_mspr_mpah.sh

# Concatenate vcf files
awk 'FNR > 1' concatenated_orthogroups_vcf/* > mmus_mspr_mpah.all_transcripts.vcf

# Only keep positions where there is a perfect match with degenotate output (some mismatch occurs because there is a big mismatch in length of the 3 species' transcripts, causing alignments to fail; others because of something is funny with "rna-ND4" transcript). Note that we are matching with the alleles that are transcribed
awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} NR==FNR {k=$1 FS $2; a[k]=$0; next} {k=$1 FS $2; if(k in a) print $0, a[k]}' <(awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $4, $3, $1, $6}' ../degenotate/degeneracy-all-sites.duplicates_removed.refs_flipped.bed | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n) <(sort -k1,1 -k2,2n mmus_mspr_mpah.all_transcripts.vcf) | awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN { FS=OFS="\t" } { $3 = toupper($3); if ($3 == $9) print $8, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5 }' > mmus_mspr_mpah.all_transcripts.degenotate_matching.vcf;

#Subset to autosomes and X
grep -E "NC_000067\.6|NC_000068\.7|NC_000068\.7|NC_000069\.6|NC_000070\.6|NC_000071\.6|NC_000072\.6|NC_000073\.6|NC_000074\.6|NC_000075\.6|NC_000076\.6|NC_000077\.6|NC_000078\.6|NC_000079\.6|NC_000080\.6|NC_000081\.6|NC_000082\.6|NC_000083\.6|NC_000084\.6|NC_000085\.6" mmus_mspr_mpah.all_transcripts.degenotate_matching.vcf > mmus_mspr_mpah.chrAUTO.degenotate_matching.vcf;
grep "NC_000086.7" mmus_mspr_mpah.all_transcripts.degenotate_matching.vcf > mmus_mspr_mpah.chrX.degenotate_matching.vcf;
```

### Merge polymorphism, substitutions and annotations

By merging annotation, polymorphism and substitution data, we can identify mutations that are associated with each polymorphism and substitution. We also calculate the derived allele frequency of the mutation (i.e., for simplicity, the frequency of the allele that is not found in the outgroup). We remove sites with missing information. We calculate the Grantham score for each mutation (polymorphic or divergent).

##### M. spretus outgroup

###### X chromosome

```{r}
# Merge all sites
mmus.X.m <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x,y,all.x=T,by=c("Chrom","Pos","ID")),list(mmus.X.ann[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","REF","REF_fwd","Gene","Transcript","Degeneracy","PROT_A","PROT_T","PROT_C","PROT_G","SIFT_A","SIFT_T","SIFT_C","SIFT_G")],mmus_mspr_mpah.X[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","SPR","PAH")],mmus.X[,c("Chrom","Pos","ID","Allele1_F","MAF","Allele1","AlleleAlt","AN")])) 
#rm(mmus.X.ann)
#rm(mmus.X)
#rm(mmus_mspr_mpah.X)

#Identify amino-acid change for each mutated site (divergent)
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="T")|(SPR=="T" & REF=="A")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                         ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="A")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="A")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                       ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="T")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_T,mmus.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                              ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="T")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_T,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                     ifelse(((SPR=="C" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="C")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_C,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
# For polymorphism data, bases are always reported relative to the forward strand 
# But if transcription happens on the reverse strand, we need the bases to be the complement
# Therefore, we take the complement whenever there is a mismatch between the referencegenome  base and the base used when predicting open reading frames
mmus.X.m$Allele1 <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="C","G",Allele1)))))
mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="C","G",AlleleAlt)))))
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_T,mmus.X.m$PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_T,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_C,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
#Derived allele frequency (frequency of allele that is not SPR, provided that SPR is not missing, and that one of the polymorphic alleles is equivalent to the reference allele)
mmus.X.m$DAF <- ifelse(mmus.X.m$SPR %in% c("A","T","G","C") & mmus.X.m$SPR==mmus.X.m$PAH & (mmus.X.m$REF==mmus.X.m$Allele1|mmus.X.m$REF==mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt) & mmus.X.m$Allele1==mmus.X.m$SPR,1-mmus.X.m$Allele1_F,ifelse(mmus.X.m$SPR %in% c("A","T","G","C") & mmus.X.m$SPR==mmus.X.m$PAH & (mmus.X.m$REF==mmus.X.m$Allele1|mmus.X.m$REF==mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt) & mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt==mmus.X.m$SPR,mmus.X.m$Allele1_F,NA))
# Identify Grantham score associated with each mutation
mmus.X.m$Grantham_divergent[!is.na(mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent[!is.na(mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_divergent)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
mmus.X.m$Grantham_polymorphic[!is.na(mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic[!is.na(mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# SIFT score for each mutation
mmus.X.m$SIFT_divergent <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="T")|(SPR=="T" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                       ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                              ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                     ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                            ifelse(((SPR=="C" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))
mmus.X.m$SIFT_polymorphic <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                              ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))

# Split sites into RR bins and record value of RR
#mmus.X.m <- mmus.X.m[order(mmus.X.m$Chrom,mmus.X.m$Pos),]
#mmus.X.m$RR_bin <- paste(mmus.X.m$Chrom,cut(mmus.X.m$Pos, breaks = rr.X$Start,include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE,labels=F),sep="_")
#mmus.X.m <- merge(mmus.X.m,rr.X[,c("Chrom","RR_bin","cM_Mb")],by=c("Chrom","RR_bin"),all.x=T)

# GC-conservative status
mmus.X.m$GC_conservative <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("A","T") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & SPR %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("A","T") & SPR %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) ,1,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("T","A") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & SPR %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("G","C") & SPR %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)),0,NA)))

#Sex bias gene expression status
#mmus.X.m <- merge(mmus.X.m,sbge_small,by=c("Flybase"),all.x=T)

#Gene age 
#mmus.X.m <- merge(mmus.X.m,gene.age,by=c("Flybase_prot"),all.x=T)

write.table(mmus.X.m,paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")
```

```{r}
                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                            ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))
mmus.X.m$SIFT_polymorphic <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                              ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))

# Split sites into RR bins and record value of RR
#mmus.X.m <- mmus.X.m[order(mmus.X.m$Chrom,mmus.X.m$Pos),]
#mmus.X.m$RR_bin <- paste(mmus.X.m$Chrom,cut(mmus.X.m$Pos, breaks = rr.X$Start,include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE,labels=F),sep="_")

# GC-conservative status
mmus.X.m$GC_conservative <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("A","T") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & PAH %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("A","T") & PAH %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) ,1,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("T","A") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & PAH %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("G","C") & PAH %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)),0,NA)))
```

```{r}
rm(mmus.A)
rm(mmus_mspr_mpah.A)

#Identify amino-acid change for each mutated site (divergent)
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="T")|(PAH=="T" & REF=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                         ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                       ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                              ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),paste(PROT_C,PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
# For polymorphism data, bases are always reported relative to the forward strand 
# But if transcription happens on the reverse strand, we need the bases to be the complement
# Therefore, we take the complement whenever there is a mismatch between the referencegenome  base and the base used when predicting open reading frames
mmus.A.m$Allele1 <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & Allele1=="C","G",Allele1)))))
mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="A","T",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="T","A",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="G","C",ifelse(REF!=REF_fwd & AlleleAlt=="C","G",AlleleAlt)))))
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_T,sep = "_"),
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),paste(PROT_A,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_C,sep = "_"),
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),paste(PROT_T,PROT_G,sep = "_"),
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),paste(PROT_C,PROT_G,sep = "_"),NA)))))))
#Derived allele frequency (frequency of allele that is not SPR, provided that SPR is not missing, and that one of the polymorphic alleles is equivalent to the reference allele)
mmus.A.m$DAF <- ifelse(mmus.A.m$PAH %in% c("A","T","G","C") & (mmus.A.m$REF==mmus.A.m$Allele1|mmus.A.m$REF==mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt) & mmus.A.m$Allele1==mmus.A.m$PAH,1-mmus.A.m$Allele1_F,ifelse(mmus.A.m$PAH %in% c("A","T","G","C") & (mmus.A.m$REF==mmus.A.m$Allele1|mmus.A.m$REF==mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt) & mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt==mmus.A.m$PAH,mmus.A.m$Allele1_F,NA))
# Identify Grantham score associated with each mutation
mmus.A.m$Grantham_divergent[!is.na(mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent[!is.na(mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_divergent)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
mmus.A.m$Grantham_polymorphic[!is.na(mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)] <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic[!is.na(mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_polymorphic)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# SIFT score for each mutation
mmus.A.m$SIFT_divergent <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="T")|(PAH=="T" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                       ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                              ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                            ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))
mmus.A.m$SIFT_polymorphic <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_T),
                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_C),
                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),abs(SIFT_A-SIFT_G),
                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_C),
                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),abs(SIFT_T-SIFT_G),
                                                                              ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),abs(SIFT_C-SIFT_G),NA)))))))

# Split sites into RR bins and record value of RR
#mmus.A.m <- mmus.A.m[order(mmus.A.m$Chrom,mmus.A.m$Pos),]
#mmus.A.m$RR_bin <- paste(mmus.A.m$Chrom,cut(mmus.A.m$Pos, breaks = rr.X$Start,include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE,labels=F),sep="_")

# GC-conservative status
mmus.A.m$GC_conservative <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("A","T") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & PAH %in% c("G","C") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("A","T") & PAH %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) ,1,ifelse( (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("T","A") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (Allele1 %in% c("G","C") & AlleleAlt %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic)) | (REF %in% c("G","C") & PAH %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)) |  (REF %in% c("G","C") & PAH %in% c("A","T") & !is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)),0,NA)))
```

### Mutational target size

#### Export

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"),h=T)
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"),h=T)

# For each site, create every possible amino acid pair
# X chromosome
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_AT <- paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_T,sep="_")
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_AC <- paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_AG <- paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_A,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_TC <- paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_T,mmus.X.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_TG <- paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_T,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
mmus.X.m$Mutation_type_CG <- paste(mmus.X.m$PROT_C,mmus.X.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
# Autosomes
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_AT <- paste(mmus.A.m$PROT_A,mmus.A.m$PROT_T,sep="_")
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_AC <- paste(mmus.A.m$PROT_A,mmus.A.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_AG <- paste(mmus.A.m$PROT_A,mmus.A.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_TC <- paste(mmus.A.m$PROT_T,mmus.A.m$PROT_C,sep="_")
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_TG <- paste(mmus.A.m$PROT_T,mmus.A.m$PROT_G,sep="_")
mmus.A.m$Mutation_type_CG <- paste(mmus.A.m$PROT_C,mmus.A.m$PROT_G,sep="_")

# Number of sites
CDS_length <- nrow(mmus.X.m)+nrow(mmus.A.m)

# Frequency of each base
A_freq <- sum(mmus.X.m$REF=="A",mmus.A.m$REF=="A")/CDS_length
T_freq <- sum(mmus.X.m$REF=="T",mmus.A.m$REF=="T")/CDS_length
C_freq <- sum(mmus.X.m$REF=="C",mmus.A.m$REF=="C")/CDS_length
G_freq <- sum(mmus.X.m$REF=="G",mmus.A.m$REF=="G")/CDS_length

# How likely is a given base to mutate to another base, given base composition and 4:1 transition to transversion ratio 
ts_tv <- 2
tv_mult <- 1 / (2 * (1 + ts_tv))
ts_mult <- ts_tv / (1 * (1 + ts_tv))
  
# Compute probabilities
mutation_probs <- c(
    Mutation_type_AT = (A_freq + T_freq) * tv_mult,
    Mutation_type_AC = (A_freq + C_freq) * tv_mult,
    Mutation_type_AG = (A_freq + G_freq) * ts_mult,
    Mutation_type_TC = (T_freq + C_freq) * ts_mult,
    Mutation_type_TG = (T_freq + G_freq) * tv_mult,
    Mutation_type_CG = (C_freq + G_freq) * tv_mult
)

nonsyn_amino_target <- c()
nonsyn_amino_AT_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_AC_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_AG_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_TC_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_TG_prob <- c()
nonsyn_amino_CG_prob <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)) {
  # Count the number of mutations that result in a given nonsynonymous amino acid pair (unweighted by ts:tv ratio or base composition)
  count_AT <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_AC <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_AG <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_TC <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_TG <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  count_CG <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == nonsyn_amino[i])
  
  # Weight counts of mutations that result in a given nonsynonymous amino acid pair by mutation probabilities (that take into account ts:tv ratio and base composition)
  weighted_sum <- count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"] +
    count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"] +
    count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"] +
    count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"] +
    count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"] +
    count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]
  
  # For each nonsynonymous amino acid pair, count total occurrences and divide by the total number of sites, to obtain mutational target size across the coding sequence
  nonsyn_amino_target[i] <- weighted_sum / CDS_length
  
  # Calculate probability that amino acid pair occurs due to a given base pairing (taking into account ts:tv ratio and base composition)
  nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i] <- (count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i] <- (count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i] <- (count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i] <- (count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i] <- (count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"]) / weighted_sum
  nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i] <- (count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"]) / weighted_sum
  
  print(i)
}


# Now for synonymous sites
syn_amino_target <- c()
syn_amino_AT_target <- c()
syn_amino_AC_target <- c()
syn_amino_AG_target <- c()
syn_amino_TC_target <- c()
syn_amino_TG_target <- c()
syn_amino_CG_target <- c()
for (i in 1:length(syn_amino)) {
  # Count the number of mutations that result in a given synonymous amino acid pair (unweighted by ts:tv ratio or base composition)
  count_AT <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AT"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_AC <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AC"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_AG <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_AG"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_TC <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TC"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_TG <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_TG"]) == syn_amino[i])
  count_CG <- sum(as.matrix(mmus.X.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == syn_amino[i]) + sum(as.matrix(mmus.A.m[, "Mutation_type_CG"]) == syn_amino[i])
  
  # Weight counts of mutations that result in a given synonymous amino acid pair by mutation probabilities (that take into account ts:tv ratio and base composition)
  weighted_sum <- count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"] +
    count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"] +
    count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"] +
    count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"] +
    count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"] +
    count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]
  
  # For each synonsmous amino acid pair, count total occurrences and divide by the total number of sites, to obtain mutational target size for given nonsynonymous amino acid pair
  syn_amino_target[i] <- weighted_sum / CDS_length
  
  # Split mutation target size by different base pairings
  syn_amino_AT_target[i] <- (count_AT * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AT"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_AC_target[i] <- (count_AC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AC"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_AG_target[i] <- (count_AG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_AG"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_TC_target[i] <- (count_TC * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TC"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_TG_target[i] <- (count_TG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_TG"]) / CDS_length
  syn_amino_CG_target[i] <- (count_CG * mutation_probs["Mutation_type_CG"]) / CDS_length
  
  print(i)
}


dd <- data.frame(cbind(nonsyn_amino,nonsyn_amino_target,nonsyn_amino_AT_prob,nonsyn_amino_AC_prob,nonsyn_amino_AG_prob,nonsyn_amino_TC_prob,nonsyn_amino_TG_prob,nonsyn_amino_CG_prob))
dd$is_zerofold <- ifelse(dd$nonsyn_amino %in% zero_amino,1,0)
write.table(dd,paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/nonsyn_amino_target.txt"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")

dd2 <- data.frame(cbind(syn_amino,syn_amino_target,syn_amino_AT_target,syn_amino_AC_target,syn_amino_AG_target,syn_amino_TC_target,syn_amino_TG_target,syn_amino_CG_target))
dd2$is_fourfold <- ifelse(dd2$syn_amino %in% four_amino,1,0)
write.table(dd2,paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/syn_amino_target.txt"),row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")

zero_amino_target <- nonsyn_amino_target[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_AT_prob <- nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_AC_prob <- nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_AG_prob <- nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_TC_prob <- nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_TG_prob <- nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]
zero_amino_CG_prob <- nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[nonsyn_amino%in% zero_amino]

four_amino_target <- syn_amino_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_AT_target <- syn_amino_AT_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_AC_target <- syn_amino_AC_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_AG_target <- syn_amino_AG_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_TC_target <- syn_amino_TC_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_TG_target <- syn_amino_TG_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]
four_amino_CG_target <- syn_amino_CG_target[syn_amino%in% four_amino]

rm(mmus.X.m)
rm(mmus.A.m)
```

### MKT (mutation size)

### M. spretus outgroup

#### Simple set-up

##### Nonsyn vs. syn

We can now set up a quick-and-dirty McDonald-Kreitman test for autosomes and X chromosomes, for each mutation type.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"))

mmus.X.m <- subset(mmus.X.m,!(is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic) & is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)))
mmus.A.m <- subset(mmus.A.m,!(is.na(Mutation_type_polymorphic) & is.na(Mutation_type_divergent)))

Dn.A <- vector()
Pn.A <- vector()
Pn.common.A <- vector()
Dn.X <- vector()
Pn.X <- vector()
Pn.common.X <- vector()
Pn_Ps.A <- vector()
alpha.A <- vector()
alpha.A.FW <- vector()
alpha.X <- vector()
alpha.X.FW <- vector()
Pn_Ps.X <- vector()
omegaA.A <- vector()
omegaA.A.FW <- vector()
omegaA.X <- vector()
omegaA.X.FW <- vector()
omegaNA.A <- vector()
omegaNA.A.FW <- vector()
omegaNA.X <- vector()
omegaNA.X.FW <- vector()
granthams <- vector()

# Synonymous sites, autosomes
Ds.A <- nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Dn.A.overall <- nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Ps.A <- nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))
Ps.common.A <- nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))

# Synonymous sites, X
Ds.X <- nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Dn.X.overall <- nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF)))
Ps.X <- nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))
Ps.common.X <- nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino))

c(Ds.A,Dn.A.overall,Ps.common.A,Ds.X,Dn.X.overall,Ps.common.X)

for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  
  granthams[i] <- as.numeric(subset(mmus.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent==nonsyn_amino[i])$Grantham_divergent[1])
  
  # Autosomes
  # Nonsynonymous sites
  Dn.A[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, Mutation_type_divergent==nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))))
  Pn.A[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt)  & DAF>0 & DAF<0.95 & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  Pn.common.A[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(mmus.A.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) & DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  
  # X chromosome
  # Nonsynonymous sites
  Dn.X[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, Mutation_type_divergent==nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))))
  Pn.X[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) &  DAF>0 & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  Pn.common.X[i] <- as.numeric(nrow(subset(mmus.X.m, (SPR==Allele1 | SPR==AlleleAlt) &  DAF>0.15  & Mutation_type_polymorphic==nonsyn_amino[i])))
  
  #Alpha values
  alpha.A[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.A))
  alpha.A.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.common.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.common.A))
  alpha.X[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.X))
  alpha.X.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.common.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.common.X))
  
  #OmegaA values
  omegaA.A[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaA.A.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.A*Pn.common.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.common.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaA.X[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  omegaA.X.FW[i] <- (1-(Ds.X*Pn.common.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.common.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  
  #OmegaNA values
  omegaNA.A[i] <- (Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)-(1-(Ds.A*Pn.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaNA.A.FW[i] <- (Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)-(1-(Ds.A*Pn.common.A[i])/(Dn.A[i]*Ps.common.A))*(Dn.A[i]/Ds.A)
  omegaNA.X[i] <- (Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)-(1-(Ds.X*Pn.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  omegaNA.X.FW[i] <- (Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)-(1-(Ds.X*Pn.common.X[i])/(Dn.X[i]*Ps.common.X))*(Dn.X[i]/Ds.X)
  
  # Pn/Ps values
  Pn_Ps.A[i] <- Pn.A[i]/Ps.A
  Pn_Ps.X[i] <- Pn.X[i]/Ps.X
  
  print(i)
}

#Prepare plots
dd <- as.data.frame(cbind(rep(granthams,2),c(alpha.X.FW,alpha.A.FW),c(omegaA.X.FW,omegaA.A.FW),c(omegaNA.X.FW,omegaNA.A.FW),c(Pn_Ps.X,Pn_Ps.A),c(rep("X",81),rep("A",81))))
names(dd) <- c("grantham_score","alpha","omegaA","omegaNA","Pn_over_Ps","chromosome")
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$grantham_score))
dd$alpha <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$alpha))
dd$omegaA <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$omegaA))
dd$omegaNA <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$omegaNA))
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- as.numeric(as.character(dd$Pn_over_Ps))
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")
```

#### Grapes set-up

##### nonsyn vs. syn

###### unfolded SFS, old (no correction for differences in mut. target size)

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

mmus.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
mmus.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=mmus.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus",iteration=i)
  mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=mmus.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus",iteration=i)
  write.table(mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_old/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_old/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(nonsyn_amino),nonsyn_amino)),paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_old/config_old.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
```

###### unfolded SFS

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"))

mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                           ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                                  ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                         ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                                ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                                       ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
mmus.X.m$REF_SPR <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="T")|(SPR=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                                         ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                                ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                       ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                              ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                                     ifelse(((SPR=="C" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
mmus.A.m$REF_SPR <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="T")|(SPR=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="C")|(SPR=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                              ifelse(((SPR=="T" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                     ifelse(((SPR=="C" & REF=="G")|(SPR=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

mmus.X.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(mmus.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus")
mmus.A.unfolded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(mmus.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus")

write.table(mmus.X.unfolded.dofe,paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
write.table(mmus.A.unfolded.dofe,paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)


grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   

  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}
```

```{r}
grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   

  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}
```

##### 0 vs. 4-fold

###### unfolded SFS, old (no correction for differences in mut. target size)

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"),h=T)
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"),h=T)

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences))),
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))),
          nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

mmus.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
mmus.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(zero_amino)){
  mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=mmus.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus",iteration=i)
  mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=mmus.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus",iteration=i)
  write.table(mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_zerofour_old/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_zerofour_old/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(zero_amino),zero_amino)),paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_zerofour_old/config_zerofour_old.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
```

```{r}
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
mmus.A.m$REF_SPR <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((SPR=="A" & REF=="T")|(SPR=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
```
