grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor,

  #3: Number of zeroonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for zeroonymous mutations
  #4: zeroonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of fouronymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is fouronymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is fouronymous)+...). This procedure subsets the fouronymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given zeroonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for fouronymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: fouronymous SFS, # histogram of fouronymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given zeroonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of zeroonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of zeroonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given zeroonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of fouronymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of fouronymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given fouronymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given zeroonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(zero_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(four_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of zeroonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for zeroonymous mutations
  #4: zeroonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of fouronymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is fouronymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is fouronymous)+...). This procedure subsets the fouronymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given zeroonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for fouronymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: fouronymous SFS, # histogram of fouronymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given zeroonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of zeroonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of zeroonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given zeroonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of fouronymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of fouronymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given fouronymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given zeroonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% zero_amino[i]& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% four_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G"& !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*zero_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% zero_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(four_amino_AT_target)*zero_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AC_target)*zero_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_AG_target)*zero_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TC_target)*zero_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(four_amino_TG_target)*zero_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(four_amino_CG_target)*zero_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% four_amino & REF_SPR=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*zero_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

mmus.X.folded.dofe <- list()
mmus.A.folded.dofe <- list()

#### Grapes import

##### nonsyn vs. syn

###### no correction for mutation target

```{r}
dd <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
dd.A <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/output_old/mmus_chrAUTO_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.A$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaExpo")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/output_old/mmus_chrX_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaExpo")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_old/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_old/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
tmpN.A <- c()
tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}
PiN_over_PiS <- do.call(rbind,PiN_over_PiS)
dd$PiN_over_PiS <- PiN_over_PiS
dd$target_size <- rep(nonsyn_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")

# Statistical tests
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.01816487, p = 0.8721
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.2116693, p = 0.05783
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaNA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.4540164, p = <0.001

names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")

# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA

# Calculate Pn/Ps

#If metric is <0, it is replaced with 0

dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0
# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()

PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()

pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_zerofour/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",zero_amino[i]),skip=2)

tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){

  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}

### M. pahari outgroup

#### Grapes set-up

##### nonsyn vs. syn

###### unfolded SFS, old (no correction for differences in mut. target size)

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mpah_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mpah_outgroup"))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
  r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
          n_sequences,
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))),
          nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
          nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
          nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
  r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
  r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
  m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
  return(m)
  }
}

mmus.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
mmus.A.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
  mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=mmus.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. pahari",iteration=i)
  mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_indiv(df=mmus.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. pahari",iteration=i)
  write.table(mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/input_old/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  write.table(mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/input_old/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}

#Config file
write.table(data.frame(cbind(1:length(nonsyn_amino),nonsyn_amino)),paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/input_old/config_old.txt"),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
```

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mpah_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mpah_outgroup"))
mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",

                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
mmus.A.m$REF_PAH <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="T")|(PAH=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                              ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino)$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

grapes_fn_indiv <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G")$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

###### folded SFS

We can also format the merged file, such that it can be imported into grapes, and a more elaborate McDonald-Kreitman test can be done.

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mpah_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mpah_outgroup"))
mmus.X.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
mmus.X.m$REF_PAH <- with(mmus.X.m,ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="T")|(PAH=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                              ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

mmus.A.m$AlleleAlt_Allele1 <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="T")|(Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_T",
                                                   ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_C",
                                                          ifelse(((Allele1=="A" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="A")),"A_G",
                                                                 ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="C")|(Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_C",
                                                                        ifelse(((Allele1=="T" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                               ifelse(((Allele1=="C" & AlleleAlt=="G")|(Allele1=="G" & AlleleAlt=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))
mmus.A.m$REF_PAH <- with(mmus.A.m,ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="T")|(PAH=="T" & REF=="A")),"A_T",
                                         ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="A")),"A_C",
                                                ifelse(((PAH=="A" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="A")),"A_G",
                                                       ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="C")|(PAH=="C" & REF=="T")),"T_C",
                                                              ifelse(((PAH=="T" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="T")),"T_G",
                                                                     ifelse(((PAH=="C" & REF=="G")|(PAH=="G" & REF=="C")),"C_G",NA)))))))

# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_all <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup){
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, 
  #5: Number of synonymous sites,  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, 
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, 
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions,
  #9: Number of synonymous sites,
  #10: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(df)*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF))))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

mmus.X.folded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(mmus.X.m,chromosome = "chrX",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. pahari")
mmus.A.folded.dofe <- grapes_fn_all(mmus.A.m,chromosome = "chrAUTO",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. pahari")

            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2])*(n_sequences/max_sequences)),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            (as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_T" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="A_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_C" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="T_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & AlleleAlt_Allele1=="C_G" & !is.na(DAF))$MAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences/2)/(n_sequences),plot=F)[2]))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(df)*nonsyn_amino_target[i],
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino[i] & is.na(DAF))),
            nrow(df)*sum(sum(syn_amino_AT_target)*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AC_target)*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_AG_target)*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TC_target)*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_TG_target)*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i],sum(syn_amino_CG_target)*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i]),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_T" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AT_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="A_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_AG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_C" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TC_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="T_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_TG_prob[i]+nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & REF_PAH=="C_G" & is.na(DAF)))*nonsyn_amino_CG_prob[i])
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

###### unfolded

```{r}
dd <- list()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
dd.A <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/output/mmus_chrAUTO_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.A$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
dd.A <- subset(dd.A,model=="GammaExpo")
dd.X <- read.csv(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/output/mmus_chrX_",nonsyn_amino[i],".csv"))
dd.X$mutation_type <- nonsyn_amino[i]
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"
dd.X <- subset(dd.X,model=="GammaExpo")
dd[[i]] <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)
}
dd <- do.call(rbind,dd)

# Assign Grantham score to each mutation type
dd$grantham_score <- as.numeric(as.character(lapply(dd$mutation_type[!is.na(dd$mutation_type)],function(x)Grantham[str_extract(x,"."),substr(str_extract(x,"..."),3,3)])))
# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

# Calculate Pi for each amino-acid pair
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
for (i in 1:length(nonsyn_amino)){
pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/input/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mpah/input/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",nonsyn_amino[i]),skip=2)
tmpN.A <- c()
tmpS.A <- c()
tmpN.X <- c()
tmpS.X <- c()
for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
}
PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
PiN_over_PiS.X[i] <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
PiN_over_PiS[[i]] <- rbind(PiN_over_PiS.A[i],PiN_over_PiS.X[i])
}
PiN_over_PiS <- do.call(rbind,PiN_over_PiS)
dd$PiN_over_PiS <- PiN_over_PiS
dd$target_size <- rep(nonsyn_amino_target,each=2)

#Sliding windows
dd <- dd[order(dd$chromosome,dd$grantham_score),]
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"] <- slide_dbl(dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"], ~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd2) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")
dd2$alpha_ratio[dd2$alpha_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$omegaA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3
dd2$omegaNA_ratio[dd2$omegaNA_ratio=="Inf"] <- 10^3

dd3 <- as.data.frame(cbind(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="X"],dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$alpha_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$omegaNA_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$Pn_over_Ps_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"],dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="X"]/dd$PiN_over_PiS_sw[dd$chromosome=="A"]))
names(dd3) <- c("grantham_score","alpha_ratio","omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")


# Statistical tests
cor.test(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],method="spearman")
# rho = -0.5905916, p = 6.497e-09
cor.test(dd$grantham_score[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$chromosome=="Autosomes"],method="spearman")
# rho = -0.5652834, p = 3.84e-08
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.1609096, p = 0.1513
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = 0.02203561, p = 0.8452
cor.test(dd2$grantham_score,dd2$omegaNA_ratio, method="spearman")
# rho = -0.05979135, p = 0.596

#### Grapes set-up

##### unfolded SFS

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"))

#Split SIFT scores into discrete categories
mmus.X.m$SIFT_divergent_discrete <- cut(mmus.X.m$SIFT_divergent,breaks=c(0,0.0499,0.9999,1),include.lowest=T,labels=F) 
mmus.X.m$SIFT_polymorphic_discrete <- cut(mmus.X.m$SIFT_polymorphic,breaks=c(0,0.0499,0.9999,1),include.lowest=T,labels=F) 
mmus.A.m$SIFT_divergent_discrete <- cut(mmus.A.m$SIFT_divergent,breaks=c(0,0.0499,0.9999,1),include.lowest=T,labels=F) 
mmus.A.m$SIFT_polymorphic_discrete <- cut(mmus.A.m$SIFT_polymorphic,breaks=c(0,0.0499,0.9999,1),include.lowest=T,labels=F) 

# Split sites into bins of coding sequence that are equal to the length of the X chromosome's coding sequence
mmus.X.m$Bin <- paste("X",1,sep="_")
bin_length <- nrow(mmus.X.m)
mmus.A.m <- mmus.A.m[order(mmus.A.m$Chrom,mmus.A.m$Pos),]
mmus.A.m$Bin <- cut(seq_along(mmus.A.m$Pos), breaks = seq(0, nrow(mmus.A.m), by = bin_length),labels = 1:(nrow(mmus.A.m) / bin_length),include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE)
mmus.A.m$Bin <- paste("A",mmus.A.m$Bin,sep="_")


# To get grapes to work, we set the maximum number of sequences in the sample to be 20 (in case it's more)
n_sequences <- 20
max_sequences <- max(mmus.A.m$AN,na.rm=T)

grapes_fn_sift_bin <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration,jiteration){
  
  #1: Descriptor, 
  #2: Total number of alleles in polymorphism dataset 
  #3: Number of nonsynonymous sites, total number of sites * probability that a site will mutate between a given amino-acid pair = total target size for nonsynonymous mutations
  #4: Nonsynonymous SFS, # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair. Finally, this is multiplied by a factor of n_sequences/max_sequences, as a way of downsampling the SFS
  #5: Number of synonymous sites, # total number of sites * (probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AT mutation * probability that an AT mutation is synonymous)+(probability that a given amino-acid pair is the result of an AC mutation + probability that an AC mutation is synonymous)+...). This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).  
  #6: Synonymous SFS, # histogram of synonymous polymorphisms, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair. # histogram of polymorphisms among a given amino-acid pair
  #7: Number of nonsynonymous sites, same as above (#3)
  #8: Number of nonsynonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair, excluding sites that are polymorphic 
  #9: Number of synonymous sites, same as above (#5)
  #10: Number of synonymous substitutions, number of substitutions among a given synonymous amino-acid pair, weighted by the probability that they are the result of a mutation type (AT, AC, etc) that occurs for given nonsynonymous amino-acid pair   
  
  if(max_sequences>n_sequences){
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & Bin==bins[i] & SIFT_polymorphic_discrete==bins_sift[j])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & Bin==bins[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2]))*(n_sequences/max_sequences),
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Bin==bins[i] & SIFT_divergent_discrete==bins_sift[j])),
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Bin==bins[i])))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
  else{
    r3 <- c(chromosome,
            n_sequences,
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% nonsyn_amino & Bin==bins[i] & SIFT_polymorphic_discrete==bins_sift[j])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            as.numeric(unlist(hist(subset(df,Mutation_type_polymorphic %in% syn_amino & Bin==bins[i])$DAF,breaks = 0:(n_sequences-1)/(n_sequences-1),plot=F)[2])),
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(nonsyn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% nonsyn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Bin==bins[i] & SIFT_divergent_discrete==bins_sift[j])),
            nrow(subset(df,Bin==bins[i]))*sum(syn_amino_target),
            nrow(subset(df,Mutation_type_divergent %in% syn_amino & is.na(DAF) & Bin==bins[i])))
    r1 <- c(paste(species,outgroup,sep=" "),rep("",length(r3)-1))
    r2 <- c("#unfolded",rep("",length(r3)-1))
    m <- rbind(r1,r2,r3)
    return(m)
  }
}

# X chromosome
bins <- levels(factor(mmus.X.m$Bin))
bins_sift <- levels(factor(mmus.X.m$SIFT_divergent_discrete))
mmus.X.unfolded.dofe <- list()
for (j in 1:length(bins_sift)){
for (i in 1:length(bins)){
  mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_sift_bin(df=mmus.X.m,chromosome = "X",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus",iteration=i,jiteration=j)
  write.table(mmus.X.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_sift/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",bins_sift[j],"_",bins[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)
}
  print(j)
}

for (i in 1:length(bins)){
  mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]] <- grapes_fn_sift_bin(df=mmus.A.m,chromosome = "Autosomes",species="M. musculus",outgroup="M. spretus",iteration=i,jiteration=j)
  write.table(mmus.A.unfolded.dofe[[i]],paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_sift/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",bins_sift[j],"_",bins[i]),quote=F,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=F)
  print(i)

grapes_fn_sift_bin <- function(df,chromosome,species,outgroup,iteration,jiteration){

This procedure subsets the synonymous mutation target size in proportion to the mutation types that generate a given nonsynonymous amin-acid pair (e.g. if a given amino-acid pair only results from C to G mutations, then the target size for synonymous mutations only considers C to G mutations).

#### Grapes import

##### unfolded

```{r}
mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"))

mmus.X.m$Bin <- paste("X",1,sep="_")
bin_length <- nrow(mmus.X.m)
mmus.A.m <- mmus.A.m[order(mmus.A.m$Chrom,mmus.A.m$Pos),]
mmus.A.m$Bin <- cut(seq_along(mmus.A.m$Pos), breaks = seq(0, nrow(mmus.A.m), by = bin_length),labels = 1:(nrow(mmus.A.m) / bin_length),include.lowest = TRUE,right = FALSE)
mmus.A.m$Bin <- paste("A",mmus.A.m$Bin,sep="_")

# X-linked bins
bins <- levels(factor(mmus.X.m$Bin))
dd.X <- list()
k <- 1
for (j in 1:3) {
  for (i in 1:length(bins)) {
    file_path <- paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/output_sift/mmus_chrX_",j, "_", bins[i], ".csv")
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dd.X.tmp <- read.csv(file_path)
      dd.X.tmp$bin  <- bins[i]
      dd.X.tmp <- subset(dd.X.tmp, model == "GammaExpo")
      dd.X.tmp$sift <- j
      dd.X[[k]] <- dd.X.tmp
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
}
dd.X <- do.call(rbind, dd.X)
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"  
#rm(mmus.X.m)

# Autosomal bins
bins <- levels(factor(mmus.A.m$Bin))
dd.A <- list()
k <- 1
for (j in 1:3) {
  for (i in 1:length(bins)) {
    file_path <- paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/output_sift/mmus_chrAUTO_",j, "_", bins[i], ".csv")
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dd.A.tmp <- read.csv(file_path)
      dd.A.tmp$bin  <- bins[i]
      dd.A.tmp <- subset(dd.A.tmp, model == "GammaExpo")
      dd.A.tmp$sift <- j
      dd.A[[k]] <- dd.A.tmp
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
}
dd.A <- do.call(rbind,dd.A)
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"
#rm(mmus.A.m)

dd <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)

# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

#Calculate Pi

dd$PiN_over_PiS <- NA
#Loop over sift bins
for (k in 1:3){
PiN_over_PiS <- list()
PiN_over_PiS.A <- c()
PiN_over_PiS.X <- c()
#Loop over autosome bins
for (i in 1:length(bins)){
  pi.A <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_sift/mmus.A.unfolded.dofe.",k,"_",bins[i]),skip=2)
  pi.X <- read.table(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/input_sift/mmus.X.unfolded.dofe.",k,"_","X_1"),skip=2)
  tmpN.A <- c()
  tmpS.A <- c()
  tmpN.X <- c()
  tmpS.X <- c()
  #Loop over frequency bins
  for (j in 1:19){
  tmpN.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.A[j] <- pi.A[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpN.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+3)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  tmpS.X[j] <- pi.X[,(j+23)]*(j/20)*(1-(j/20))*2
  }
  PiN_over_PiS.A[i] <- (sum(tmpN.A)/pi.A[,3])/(sum(tmpS.A)/pi.A[,23])
  PiN_over_PiS.X <- (sum(tmpN.X)/pi.X[,3])/(sum(tmpS.X)/pi.X[,23])
  }
PiN_over_PiS <- c(PiN_over_PiS.A,PiN_over_PiS.X)
dd$PiN_over_PiS[dd$sift==k] <- PiN_over_PiS
}

# For each X-linked bin (there is only one), pair with a random autosomal bin, and calculate X/A ratios of the relevant metrics
set.seed(123)
omegaA.r <- vector()
omegaNA.r <- vector()
Pn_over_Ps.r <- vector()
PiN_over_PiS.r <- vector()
k <- 1
for (j in 1:3){
for (i in 1:1000){
  dd.X <- subset(dd,chromosome=="X" & sift==j)
  dd.A <- subset(dd,chromosome=="A" & sift==j)
  s.X <- dd.X[,c("chromosome","Pn_over_Ps","PiN_over_PiS","omegaA","omegaNA")]
  s.A <- dd.A[sample(nrow(dd.A),1),c("chromosome","Pn_over_Ps","PiN_over_PiS","omegaA","omegaNA")]
  omegaA.r[k] <- s.X$omegaA/s.A$omegaA
  omegaNA.r[k] <- s.X$omegaNA/s.A$omegaNA
  Pn_over_Ps.r[k] <- s.X$Pn_over_Ps/s.A$Pn_over_Ps
  PiN_over_PiS.r[k] <- s.X$PiN_over_PiS/s.A$PiN_over_PiS
  k <- k + 1
}
}

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- data.frame(omegaA.r,omegaNA.r,Pn_over_Ps.r,PiN_over_PiS.r)
names(dd2) <- c("omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio","PiN_over_PiS_ratio")
dd2$sift <- c(rep("1",1000),rep("2",1000),rep("3",1000))
dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$omegaA_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3
dd2$omegaNA_ratio[dd2$omegaNA_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3
dd2$Pn_over_Ps_ratio[dd2$Pn_over_Ps_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3
dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio[dd2$PiN_over_PiS_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")
dd$sift <- as.factor(dd$sift)
levels(dd$sift) <- c("tolerated","Partly conserved","Fully conserved")
dd2$sift <- as.factor(dd2$sift)
levels(dd2$sift) <- c("tolerated","Partly conserved","Fully conserved")

mmus.X.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.X.m.mspr_outgroup"))
mmus.A.m <- fread(paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/mmus.A.m.mspr_outgroup"))

# X-linked bins
bins <- levels(factor(mmus.X.m$Bin))
dd.X <- list()

  for (i in 1:length(bins)) {

    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dd.X.tmp <- read.csv(file_path)
      dd.X.tmp$bin  <- bins[i]
      dd.X.tmp <- subset(dd.X.tmp, model == "GammaZero")

      dd.X[[k]] <- dd.X.tmp
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
}
dd.X <- do.call(rbind, dd.X)
dd.X$chromosome <- "X"  


# Autosomal bins
bins <- levels(factor(mmus.A.m$Bin))
dd.A <- list()
k <- 1
for (j in 1:3) {
  for (i in 1:length(bins)) {
    file_path <- paste0(dir,"mmus/mkt/grapes/mspr/output_sift/mmus_chrAUTO_folded_",j, "_", bins[i], ".csv")
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dd.A.tmp <- read.csv(file_path)
      dd.A.tmp$bin  <- bins[i]
      dd.A.tmp <- subset(dd.A.tmp, model == "GammaZero")
      dd.A.tmp$sift <- j
      dd.A[[k]] <- dd.A.tmp
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
}
dd.A <- do.call(rbind,dd.A)
dd.A$chromosome <- "A"

rm(mmus.A.m)
rm(mmus.X.m)

dd <- rbind(dd.A,dd.X)

# Calculate omegaNA from alpha and omegaA
dd$omegaNA <- (dd$omegaA*(1-dd$alpha))/dd$alpha
# Calculate Pn/Ps (actually theta)
dd$Pn_over_Ps <- (dd$pn/dd$Lpn)/(dd$ps/dd$Lps)
#If metric is <0, it is recorded as 0
dd$omegaA[dd$omegaA<0] <- 0
dd$omegaNA[dd$omegaNA<0] <- 0
dd$alpha[dd$alpha<0] <- 0
dd$Pn_over_Ps[dd$Pn_over_Ps<0] <- 0

# For each X-linked gene, pair with a random autosomal gene, and calculate X/A ratios of the relevant metrics
set.seed(123)
omegaA.r <- vector()
omegaNA.r <- vector()
Pn_over_Ps.r <- vector()
k <- 1
for (j in 1:3){
for (i in 1:1000){
  dd.X <- subset(dd,chromosome=="X" & sift==j)
  dd.A <- subset(dd,chromosome=="A" & sift==j)
  s.X <- dd.X[,c("chromosome","Pn_over_Ps","omegaA","omegaNA")]
  s.A <- dd.A[sample(nrow(dd.A),1),c("chromosome","Pn_over_Ps","omegaA","omegaNA")]
  omegaA.r[k] <- s.X$omegaA/s.A$omegaA
  omegaNA.r[k] <- s.X$omegaNA/s.A$omegaNA
  Pn_over_Ps.r[k] <- s.X$Pn_over_Ps/s.A$Pn_over_Ps
  k <- k + 1
}
}

# Dataframe for X/A ratio plots
dd2 <- data.frame(omegaA.r,omegaNA.r,Pn_over_Ps.r)
names(dd2) <- c("omegaA_ratio","omegaNA_ratio","Pn_over_Ps_ratio")
dd2$sift <- c(rep("1",1000),rep("2",1000),rep("3",1000))
dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$omegaA_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3
dd2$omegaNA_ratio[dd2$omegaNA_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3
dd2$Pn_over_Ps_ratio[dd2$Pn_over_Ps_ratio=="Inf"] <-  10^3

dd$chromosome <- factor(dd$chromosome)
levels(dd$chromosome) <- c("Autosomes","X")
dd$sift <- as.factor(dd$sift)
levels(dd$sift) <- c("tolerated","Partly conserved","Fully conserved")
dd2$sift <- as.factor(dd2$sift)
levels(dd2$sift) <- c("tolerated","Partly conserved","Fully conserved")

# Statistical tests
sum(dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$sift=="Fully conserved"]<dd2$omegaA_ratio[dd2$sift=="Partly conserved"])/1000
# p = 0.081
